name: Ryan Zinke - Navy SEAL
subject: Closing the curtains on my campaign
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Zinke for Congress
body:
I'm at my wits' end, Peter. Pelosi and the Democrats just have too much power, too many connections, and too much in their fundraising war chest. At this point, if I don't do a total 180 on the fundraising front, not only will my race be in danger, **_but Republicans may never win another race this year._** **Peter, this is Ryan Zinke. I served as President Trump 's Secretary of the Interior and I was the commander at SEAL Team 6.** **I 'm also running for Congress in the most critical race in the nation. I will never give up on this race, I will never back down - because Navy SEALs never quit.** But if Pelosi can destroy me in this race, I can guarantee you no other Republican will have a chance. **I have Trump 's endorsement, I lead the team of Navy SEAL's running for Congress, and I have more battle experience than anyone else.** [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61475695:JAI8v9VwN:m:1:3334294963:E5365B613605EE259D66DD60848DD138:r) The point is, Peter, I'm the toughest Republican running for office. If I can't beat Pelosi - no one can. So, I'm going to be blunt with you. [**If you chip in just $25 right now**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61475695:JAI8v9VwN:m:1:3334294963:E5365B613605EE259D66DD60848DD138:r), I can promise you that we will blow my fundraising goal out of the water and ruin Pelosi's plan to destroy our nation. I'm humbly asking you, as a warrior who's fought for this nation for my entire life, will you help me out? [**DONATE TODAY**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61475695:JAI8v9VwN:m:1:3334294963:E5365B613605EE259D66DD60848DD138:r) You have my word, as a former Navy SEAL and commander at SEAL Team 6, if you help me out, I will return the favor in Congress. Thank you for your support, Ryan Zinke [**DONATE TODAY**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61475695:JAI8v9VwN:m:1:3334294963:E5365B613605EE259D66DD60848DD138:r)

| | | _**I 'm not asking for money, just your signature.**_

_**[You may not know me, Peter, so let me share my story.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61477939:6Lj6d9VNm:m:1:3253819041:B349FD41024A6E1C503761413C7C43D1:r "You may not know me, Peter, so let
me share my story.")**_

My name's Tiffany Smiley. I'm a mom of 3, veteran's wife, and Republican candidate for U.S. Senate in Washington.

I'm running against a 30-year Democrat incumbent to bring _**real change**_ to our country.

I married my high school sweetheart, Scotty, who was permanently blinded by a suicide bomber while serving in Iraq.

From there, I took on the federal government to fight for the rights that Scotty earned as an active duty service member, and I **won**.

Fighting for Scotty inspired me to advocate for all veterans, so I went to D.C. to speak up for those who put their lives on the line for our country.

_**[Now, I need your help to send me to D.C. to advocate for Washingtonians and all Americans who have been hurt by the terrible policies of Joe Biden and my Democrat opponent Patty Murray.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61477939:6Lj6d9VNm:m:1:3253819041:B349FD41024A6E1C503761413C7C43D1:r "Now, I need your help to send me to
D.C. to advocate for Washingtonians and all Americans who have been hurt by the terrible policies of Joe Biden and my Democrat opponent Patty
Murray.")**_

Murray has been in office for 3 decades and has done _**nothing**_ to stop the rising crime, homelessness, and drug addiction crisis tearing my beloved home state apart.

I'm running for U.S. Senate because Americans deserve better than the _**failed**_ leadership they've been stuck with for _**years**_.

It's time for a change in D.C., and I'm the right person for the job.

The latest polls in Washington show that my opponent and I will be neck and neck, and I'm getting nervous. We're finally closing in on Murray, but I need your support to cross the finish line.

Can you endorse my campaign to help me take the lead to save Washington?

Tiffany Smiley

name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: This is a long, but very personal message
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
| |
---
| | | Peter,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61478315:J6rOH9VdN:m:1:3253819041:91D01B10B438FE73969DD119DD561DBC:r "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of
hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61478315:J6rOH9VdN:m:1:3253819041:91D01B10B438FE73969DD119DD561DBC:r "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61478315:J6rOH9VdN:m:1:3253819041:91D01B10B438FE73969DD119DD561DBC:r "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61478315:J6rOH9VdN:m:1:3253819041:91D01B10B438FE73969DD119DD561DBC:r "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61478315:J6rOH9VdN:m:1:3253819041:91D01B10B438FE73969DD119DD561DBC:r "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and
every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61478315:J6rOH9VdN:m:1:3253819041:91D01B10B438FE73969DD119DD561DBC:r "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind
active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61478315:J6rOH9VdN:m:1:3253819041:91D01B10B438FE73969DD119DD561DBC:r "I will always stand up for our heroes
and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61478315:J6rOH9VdN:m:1:3253819041:91D01B10B438FE73969DD119DD561DBC:r "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61478315:J6rOH9VdN:m:1:3253819041:91D01B10B438FE73969DD119DD561DBC:r "Washingtonians need a voice to find
solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61478315:J6rOH9VdN:m:1:3253819041:91D01B10B438FE73969DD119DD561DBC:r "So please, can you chip in just a
few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far. ")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61478315:J6rOH9VdN:m:1:3253819041:91D01B10B438FE73969DD119DD561DBC:r "KEEP
TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61478315:J6rOH9VdN:m:1:3253819041:91D01B10B438FE73969DD119DD561DBC:r "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| |

---
* * *
---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61478316:J6rOH9VdN:m:1:3253819041:91D01B10B438FE73969DD119DD561DBC:r "All Eyes On Washington")
---
Peter, it's Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Hello,
My mother worked alongside my dad in Lebanon Farm Shop well into their 70s. They refused assistance from their many children even after they lost their life savings in the Savings and Loan debacle of the 1980s. My mom in coveralls, petite as she was, handing tools to my dad is an indelible image I carry with me to this day.
My dad built a business repairing farm implements. In a way, I think he hoped that I’d stick around and take it over, but that wasn’t to be. I joined the Navy after getting a scholarship and my life as a machinist and welder came to a close.
Dad said very little about his service in the Second World War. He had the burns and shrapnel of his first ship sinking, and would provide some quips about surviving a night amongst the flotsam and death off Guadalcanal, but he didn’t dissuade me from enlisting. My mom had the bravery in saying quite simply, “The healthy bird flees the nest.” She wiped her eyes on her apron as I drove up the hill on my way to ‘boot camp.’ It took me some time to understand why.
You could say my mom and dad embodied rural Iowa values in their unique ways: Family, hard work, sacrifice, education, and honesty. And I think of them every day on the campaign trail, because it’s those values that drove me to run for political office.
**After nearly 4 decades serving in the United States Navy, I’m running for Senate against Chuck Grassley because it’s time politicians in Washington fight for everyday people like my folks.**
The polls have all shown this will be a very close race, so of course, I’m facing millions of dollars in Super PAC attacks. I don’t come from some political dynasty, and I’m not taking corporate PAC money. Instead, I’m relying entirely on the donations of generous grassroots donors like you.
**There’s 48 hours until our most important fundraising deadline yet, and right now we’re still short of our $45,000 goal and what we need to defeat Chuck Grassley and win. So I have to ask:**
[**Please, may I count on you to make a donation to my campaign today – before our fundraising deadline? name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: My story in pictures
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
| |
---
| | | Peter,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61477967:JE8qW9VNz:m:1:3317145305:CF9EF09458FCBC0803B7523A6E6F2766:r "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of
hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61477967:JE8qW9VNz:m:1:3317145305:CF9EF09458FCBC0803B7523A6E6F2766:r "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61477967:JE8qW9VNz:m:1:3317145305:CF9EF09458FCBC0803B7523A6E6F2766:r "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61477967:JE8qW9VNz:m:1:3317145305:CF9EF09458FCBC0803B7523A6E6F2766:r "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61477967:JE8qW9VNz:m:1:3317145305:CF9EF09458FCBC0803B7523A6E6F2766:r "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and
every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61477967:JE8qW9VNz:m:1:3317145305:CF9EF09458FCBC0803B7523A6E6F2766:r "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind
active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61477967:JE8qW9VNz:m:1:3317145305:CF9EF09458FCBC0803B7523A6E6F2766:r "I will always
stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61477967:JE8qW9VNz:m:1:3317145305:CF9EF09458FCBC0803B7523A6E6F2766:r "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61477967:JE8qW9VNz:m:1:3317145305:CF9EF09458FCBC0803B7523A6E6F2766:r "Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61477967:JE8qW9VNz:m:1:3317145305:CF9EF09458FCBC0803B7523A6E6F2766:r "So please, can you chip in just a
few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far. ")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61477967:JE8qW9VNz:m:1:3317145305:CF9EF09458FCBC0803B7523A6E6F2766:r "KEEP
TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61477967:JE8qW9VNz:m:1:3317145305:CF9EF09458FCBC0803B7523A6E6F2766:r "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| |

---
* * *
---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61477968:JE8qW9VNz:m:1:3317145305:CF9EF09458FCBC0803B7523A6E6F2766:r "All
Eyes On Washington")
---
Hey, it's Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can't make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61477968:JE8qW9VNz:m:1:3317145305:CF9EF09458FCBC0803B7523A6E6F2766:r "Rush support now to be a part of
history")**_.

Let's raise money and WIN,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| | | [JOIN TEAM SMILEY](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61477968:JE8qW9VNz:m:1:3317145305:CF9EF09458FCBC0803B7523A6E6F2766:r "JOIN TEAM
SMILEY")
---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61477969:JE8qW9VNz:m:1:3317145305:CF9EF09458FCBC0803B7523A6E6F2766:r "Alert!")
---

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61477970:JE8qW9VNz:m:1:3317145305:CF9EF09458FCBC0803B7523A6E6F2766:r "That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!")**_

This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple.

Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum!

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61477970:JE8qW9VNz:m:1:3317145305:CF9EF09458FCBC0803B7523A6E6F2766:r "Step up
now!")**_

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61478396:6vkr79VNL:m:1:3331421248:AC5AF9FEC0863E043997AFE30363A537:r "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of
hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61478396:6vkr79VNL:m:1:3331421248:AC5AF9FEC0863E043997AFE30363A537:r "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61478396:6vkr79VNL:m:1:3331421248:AC5AF9FEC0863E043997AFE30363A537:r "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61478396:6vkr79VNL:m:1:3331421248:AC5AF9FEC0863E043997AFE30363A537:r "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61478396:6vkr79VNL:m:1:3331421248:AC5AF9FEC0863E043997AFE30363A537:r "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and
every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61478396:6vkr79VNL:m:1:3331421248:AC5AF9FEC0863E043997AFE30363A537:r "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind
active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61478396:6vkr79VNL:m:1:3331421248:AC5AF9FEC0863E043997AFE30363A537:r "I will always stand up for our heroes
and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61478396:6vkr79VNL:m:1:3331421248:AC5AF9FEC0863E043997AFE30363A537:r "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61478396:6vkr79VNL:m:1:3331421248:AC5AF9FEC0863E043997AFE30363A537:r "Washingtonians need a voice to find
solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61478396:6vkr79VNL:m:1:3331421248:AC5AF9FEC0863E043997AFE30363A537:r "So please, can you chip in just a
few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far. ")**_

---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

We are in an uphill battle, and I can't make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61477089:6Oie79VsN:m:1:3350876382:686BE22311CB58DA94E8C055268EEA57:r "Johnson1")**_

Please, Peter, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

name: Shamaine Daniels
subject: We're Celebrating!
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/barbacoa?refcode=email [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/barbacoa?refcode=email]
October is Hispanic Heritage Month and Team Daniels is celebrating with a weekend of action!
I'm proud to be an American, and I'm proud of my Venezuelan heritage. If elected, I will be the first Latina to serve Pennsylvania in the U.S. Congress. I would like to personally invite you to join me as we celebrate Hispanic Heritage month by reaching out to LatinX voters throughout PA-10 to get them to turn out on Election Day.
Beginning this Thursday, October 6th, we have a long weekend of voter outreach and fundraising planned and we would love it if you can join us!
On Thursday, we will be canvassing and phonebanking in Harrisburg with a VERY SPECIAL GUEST - Chef Christina Martinez of South Philly Barbacoa. Chef Martinez was the winner of the 2022 James Beard Award and was featured on Netflix's "The Chef's Table."
To join us on Thursday for canvassing with Chef Martinez, sign-up HERE. [https://forms.gle/q17n2DMQmFyY4yeB6]
To sign-up for phonebanking, CLICK HERE. [https://forms.gle/b8ZzMXVy5tuxbfmSA]
On Friday, the celebrations continue with our Hispanic Heritage Month Fundraiser at Cafe De Olla, 210 N. 3rd Street in Harrisburg from 5:30PM to 7:30PM. To buy your ticket and make a contribution to the campaign, CLICK HERE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/barbacoa?refcode=email]
Saturday and Sunday we'll have canvasses throughout the district, and we would be thrilled if you can join us. To sign-up, CLICK HERE [https://forms.gle/q17n2DMQmFyY4yeB6]
I hope you'll join us for one of these events because your support could make the difference!
Thank you, and I hope to see you this weekend!
- Shamaine

Harrisburg, PA 17102

name: Admiral Mike Franken
subject: Fox News puts our troops in jeopardy
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Seth Moulton for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-franken?refcode=221003 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-franken?refcode=221003]
Will you split a donation between Admiral Mike Franken's campaign and Seth Moulton today and do your part to flip Iowa from red to blue and protect our Democratic Senate majority? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-franken?refcode=221003]
Friend,
As bombs began raining down on Ukrainian cities, Donald Trump called into Fox News to blame – you guessed it – Joe Biden and Hillary Clinton.
As Russian tanks began pouring over the Ukrainian border, Fox News host Laura Ingraham had the gall to call Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy “pathetic.”
And if you tune into Tucker Carlson these days, you’ll see a show that might as well have been written and produced by Russian state media. Fox News showcases the chasm between traditional GOP normative behavior and the fringe-right cabal now headed by Donald J. Trump.
As the commander of military forces in East Africa, I asked the American Forces Network to replace Fox News during meal hours for troops. Why? Because they were harmful to America's outreach overseas. They put our troops in jeopardy and made my job harder.
Without Fox News, Trump would have only ever been a bungling celebrity who foolishly and laughably ran for president.
Real-time reckoning of lies needs real-time litigation. There is such a thing as gross distortions of fact and purveyors of such must pay a debilitating price. My answer to Fox when I was an admiral in the U.S. Navy? I pulled the plug.
When I defeat Chuck Grassley and turn Iowa blue this November, I will be the most senior military person ever elected to the United States Senate. And I think it’s about time we had more people in leadership who understand the true costs of war and media manipulation of facts, commonly called disinformation.
The polls show we can win. The pundits say we must win. And with your help today, we can fight back against McConnell’s Super PAC lies and protect our Democratic majority in the Senate.
We’ve set a goal of raising another $100,000 before midnight, but right now, we’re still short. If we’re going to defeat Chuck Grassley and turn Iowa blue, I’m counting on grassroots donors like you to give now:
Please, will you split a donation of $27 or more right now between my campaign and Seth Moulton – whatever you can afford before midnight tonight – to help me defeat Chuck Grassley, turn Iowa blue, and protect our Democratic Senate majority? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-franken?refcode=221003]
Fox News’ propaganda cannot go unanswered. But it takes significant funding to run a full-scale campaign and take on all of Grassley’s and McConnell’s lies.
I’m not taking a dime of corporate PAC money, so whatever you can give today will go a long way.
I am so thankful to have you on the team,
Mike Franken, U.S. Navy (ret.)
Donate [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-franken?refcode=221003]

Fellow Conservative: The stakes in the upcoming mid-term elections could not be higher, and we are witnessing one of the best political environments for Republicans in a long time.
Now is the time for us to be bold and support as many strong, viable conservative candidates as we possibly can.
RINOs won't do. They do more harm than good. We need rock-solid, fighting conservatives who will keep their word and fight for our freedoms in Washington.
**That's why we are supporting twelve – yes, TWELVE – additional candidates today.** ▶︎ Mike Collins (GA-10)

As you know, the House Freedom Fund donates the maximum amount allowed by law from our PAC to these candidates, and then we spend as much as we can getting freedom-loving Americans across the nation to donate directly to their campaigns.
**[Our grassroots model allows us to bundle large sums for our candidates that make the difference in their campaigns.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zpd5npj68abpd02s31hbn7sftms6hjnij3hn6o60_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3i68p72chh2bs)**
We are very excited about the opportunity we have to send a large group of conservatives to Washington who will join the House Freedom Caucus and work together to stop the Left and the GOP Establishment from further destroying our country.
_But we can't do it without your help._
**[So please take action now and give as generously as you can so we can push these candidates on to victory.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zob4gh8qj6umfl5jma473cvq2cu59ldh3mc52jqo_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3i68p72chh2bs)**

Fellow Conservative,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

[_**Please support the BLEXIT Foundation 's mission today by helping me reach our goal of raising $25,000 from new online donors. You can click here to donate.**_](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=33bf4e6340e9461bbf91a28e91613afa&_e=jS7U-XxbUNfqI0XjG9Q4ti5qJfvXFbgR8HHTxlS9EhOScsHWOpF6xmrYijEePi2NNl2xu-x1pOuAxzuF98WCFbC7OMH9CCfmRvPrufVKkHjCa1JWDZD2gYV_VeduOCTLzuc0aFlIDEkm07jFWSk5W7F9m_Nq8eAvNdlh2oNergFndkNQfrH5E-zWlSCzaq4-NJnkDfkFVpMS1927fZHKWy_PRu_ImXBiBduGuGXLpB4%3D)

**_Now I 'll share my story_... racism, death threats, and empowering black communities.**

Growing up as a black woman, I can recall learning how "helpless" I was told I was. And this message - which the media forces Black Americans to listen to - is heartbreaking.

We're taught to believe we're victims, that nothing will ever change, the police are our enemies, and racism prevents us from ever achieving our goals.

This is WRONG.

I've dealt with racism... _**I 've even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

But the solution is NOT to become a victim and give up.

I created the BLEXIT Foundation to empower black communities, minorities, and the people in my life whom I love. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with over 41 grassroots chapter programs in 41 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters.

[_**Fellow Conservative, I am inviting you to support the BLEXIT Foundation and help us spread our winning message of entrepreneurship, school choice, faith, and family. My goal is to raise $25,000 from online supporters to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $10, $50, $100, $250, $500, $1,000 or any amount. **_](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=33bf4e6340e9461bbf91a28e91613afa&_e=jS7U-XxbUNfqI0XjG9Q4ti5qJfvXFbgR8HHTxlS9EhOScsHWOpF6xmrYijEePi2NNl2xu-x1pOuAxzuF98WCFVh9aleNGkDNuu9QSlNPBirWvdAEChkDkHy2MPJcfPkDCg7H8lHrllqAxRZpj8q8wDIwnxKAU-R3wcgE7IRm0B4JBMFIpFdGPCWBxIA_yqypgLve21gXYv_dxFn6UaeC3PNTqUP9ieMoLuKhqFt09cc%3D)

I am breaking the rules.

It seems like every email I receive in my inbox engages in fear-mongering, makes big promises, and demands you and I make a donation without any of the details... _I 'm not doing that_.

You should know the details, believe in our mission, and understand how BLEXIT is changing the direction of our urban communities and our country.

So I am taking a risk by sending you a long email with all the details to empower YOU to choose to support the BLEXIT Foundation.**Please read to the end of this email (I have an important message at the end you don 't want to miss).**

When I founded BLEXIT, I wanted to make sure above all else we were NOT just a "think tank", but rather we pride ourselves on being a thoughtful and quick acting "DO-tank". We're doing things no other organization in the country is doing.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=33bf4e6340e9461bbf91a28e91613afa&_e=jS7U-XxbUNfqI0XjG9Q4ti5qJfvXFbgR8HHTxlS9EhOScsHWOpF6xmrYijEePi2NNl2xu-x1pOuAxzuF98WCFYeCnvJXW6flEjigvhcPT7AcGEGdosvzDLtAs80HpqDGrQl7BvIALCRE8kwYH6MubZNplnh4R3TFXm-yInId6xouOwMS9uNbaVdxPxdDWCZpKRIGydu99KuyAJHLVIFA13WL3ybHn9YwPaowkIAD3Bc%3D)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: My story in pictures
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
I wanted to share these special moments with you. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c0898%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=gCduz9uiJ6IvxEjuYpeO5Q&sysid=1)
I wanted to share these special moments with you.

| |
---
| | | Friend,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I’m running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c45995%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=3ZRnY1Okl8yBwkkTzxmSVw&sysid=1 "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c45996%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=uqCh2OF%2b%2btcnwAYonQjIoA&sysid=1 "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c45997%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=G2lN9pw%2foG03pilUcEGmEw&sysid=1 "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty’s side.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c45998%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=F825cPMXVRZ8POw1w9FqQg&sysid=1 "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty’s immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c45999%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=LhI6PpJrTSXedLs1pzuVeg&sysid=1 "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran
gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c45990%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=gF%2fZInl8ZHpOzHgJnILLsA&sysid=1 "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer,
breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It’s not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c45991%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=v69uTPxBdJVmlO00iTslBQ&sysid=1 "I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for
our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to ‘see’ our children’s faces, he’s always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c45992%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=xhUxO13AYg%2f%2b2lMku529Gw&sysid=1 "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I’ve shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c45993%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=8RBknixV4cGf%2bm2feqD9Rg&sysid=1 "Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and
end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can’t do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c45994%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=yKG2u5972AZqWZ%2fH05b2wQ&sysid=1 "So please, can you chip in just a few bucks
to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far. ")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c45905%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=NCol%2fBoFIkxQN%2fGnjWR7WQ&sysid=1 "KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c45906%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=eBfIvH1aPHdO%2bKBKKpbZ6Q&sysid=1 "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| |

---
* * *
---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c45907%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=tflhpN7fxN9YNlMeOzoo2A&sysid=1 "All Eyes On Washington")
---
Hey, it’s Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can’t make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c45908%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=jx1w0dXrXZQHv6Qd05w7gA&sysid=1 "Rush support now to be a part of
history")**_.

Let’s raise money and WIN,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| | | [JOIN TEAM SMILEY](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c45909%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=%2bDTAQ3s%2bMAlo3Gnocget0w&sysid=1 "JOIN TEAM SMILEY")
---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c45900%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=PWv4aPUVcKOlMoFEBSKJ3Q&sysid=1 "Alert!")
---

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c45901%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Sgb7c%2ftAhxV%2bO1fp2aT7Ug&sysid=1 "That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help

# Pete Coors Endorsement
---
|
---
| | |
---|---
|
Today, Erik Aadland, CD7 Republican candidate for Congress, announces a formal endorsement from businessman, Pete Coors.

Pete Coors is a native of the State of Colorado and great-grandson of Adolph Coors, who founded the Golden brewery in 1873. He currently serves as chairman of Molson Coors Beverage Company. Now retired from active employment, he has served in several executive positions including president and chairman of Coors Brewing Company and chairman of Molson Coors Brewing Company.

Coors is also a manager of Keystone Holdings LLC and a director of Adolph Coors Company LLC, the trust company serving as trustee of various Coors family trusts.

Coors attended Cornell University where he received his bachelor's degree in industrial engineering in 1969. He earned his master's degree in business administration from the University of Denver in 1970. He also has received honorary degrees from Regis University (1991), Wilberforce University (1992), Johnson & Wales University (1997) and Colorado State University (2011).

Coors civic responsibilities include serving as Director of the American Enterprise Institute, the Denver Art Museum Foundation and the Western Stock Show Association. In 2019, he was appointed as the Civilian Aide to the Secretary of the Army - Colorado (North). He is also a member of the Intercontinental Chapter of Young Presidents Organization and sits on the National Advisory Board of ACE Scholarships. Coors is also past president and trustee emeritus of the Denver Area Council of Boy Scouts of America.
---
| In a statement sent to Erik Aadland's campaign, Coors said:
"I wholeheartedly support Erik Aadland's candidacy for Congress in Colorado's 7th Congressional District. It is clear that even though Erik never designed his life to run for public office, his experiences--combat veteran, energy sector leader, husband and father--have led him to this moment as a Congressional candidate. I truly believe Erik, as a U.S. Army veteran, views his run for Congress as a new tour of duty to serve his fellow citizens. This is exactly what we need. 2022 is not the year for career politicians to continue the status quo, but rather for fresh ideas and servant leadership. Erik Aadland is a champion we can send to Congress to make the difference we so desperately need. He is exactly what we are all looking for in our future political leaders"
---
| |
---
---
|
# Erik's Remarks
---
| |
---
|
---
| "Mr. Coors' endorsement is a great honor. Pete has been part of the political and business community in Colorado for many years, and as such he has seen many would-be leaders come and go. I am humbled to know that his experience has led him to advocate for me as the best representative of CD7's citizens. I especially appreciate his understanding of the gravity with which I approach this mission to restore and protect Americans' prosperity. Pete's encouragement only further reinforces my commitment to increasing opportunities and making Coloradans' lives better."

name: Cristen Wohlgemuth
subject: Push back against this injustice
body:
Michael and Chantell Sackett have been fighting for 15 years to build a home on the private property they own near Priest Lake i
| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zujlurqevdmtnneeqaqustusd336h8qtc9em9pj8_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3i62or6cph2bs)
---
| | Dear Friend of Liberty, Michael and Chantell Sackett have been fighting for 15 years to build a home on the private property they own near Priest Lake in Bonner County, Idaho. It’s not for the usual reasons like a lack of building supplies or unresponsive contractors. It’s because the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) declared that their land is a wetland. But here’s the kicker. The Sacketts’ land is not wet. There’s no water on it! Still, the government is going after them. And if the couple doesn’t comply with the EPA’s outlandish regulations, they could face fines up to $32,500 _per day_! The Sacketts have been dragged through the courts for years fighting for their property rights—**and yours**. Now, their case will be argued before the U.S. Supreme Court. And MSLF has lent them support in their fight against this blatant government overreach. That’s why I’m emailing you today with a special request. I’m hoping you will stand with the Sacketts and show them you support their fight by signing our petition today. If the EPA is allowed to trample the lives of private citizens like the Sacketts with no opposition, there’s no telling who could be next. But your voice today will push back against this injustice and show the government that you stand for freedom and the private property rights of every American citizen. **Please sign the petition below declaring your desire to stand against this blatant overreach by the EPA.**
* I am standing for the private property rights of Michael and Chantell Sackett.
* I am standing against unelected bureaucracies that threaten the rights of individual citizens.
* I am asking the U.S. Supreme Court to rule against the EPA’s blatant government overreach.

Please sign our petition right now at this secure link: **[https://mslegal.org/subscribe/sackett-petition/](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zrgrmh5gfnjoauc096uqr90au22aoohqr4hg0u10_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3i62or6cph2bs)** For Liberty! Cristen Wohlgemuth President & CEO Mountain States Legal Foundation

body:
Gas prices have risen dramatically since the Biden administration took office, and I’m sure you’ve felt the pinch at the pum
| | | [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z94vcfocrm81jt17jvbrok2n34leo7vbnq4g1asg_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3i66ob4c3h2bs)
---
| | Dear Fellow Conservative, Gas prices have risen dramatically since the Biden administration took office, and I’m sure you’ve felt the pinch at the pump just like the rest of your fellow Americans. There’s no doubt in my mind that our nation’s citizens are in need of relief. But instead, President Biden has throttled U.S. energy production. And he has trapped much of our nation’s vast energy reserves behind a wall of bureaucratic red tape. That’s why I’m sending you this email today. President Biden is _" canceling"_ (transferring) student debt for millions of Americans . . .And forcing the rest of us to pay for it.

subject: What did they really think?
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vWx3ATnhCN

I'm sure you've often wondered why we haven't produced an online
course on the American Founding-we're Hillsdale College, after
all.

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWx3ATnhCN

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Greetings
friend,

I'm sure
you've often wondered why we haven't produced an online course on
the American Founding-we're Hillsdale College, after all.

Well,
here it is!

Hillsdale
professor of politics, Thomas G. West is one of the great
scholars and teachers of the American Founding and the author of
The Political Theory of the American Founding and Vindicating the
Founders.

In this
new course, Dr. West sits down with his former student and
current professor at Hillsdale's Graduate School of Government,
David Azerrad, to reveal the truth about the American Founding.

As Dr.
West explains, the Founders' political theory is so foreign to
Americans today-even to scholars and teachers of American history
and politics-that the task of uncovering the truth about the
Founding is like unearthing something from a "deep and
long-forgotten pit."

This
course goes about this task by examining the primary arguments
and decisions of the Founders, and it brings their theory to life
by comparing it to the dominant views of contemporary America.

The
result is an exciting, and often surprising, account of how the
Founders established a free government in America and what they
thought was necessary to sustain it.

That's
why we're releasing our new free online course, "The Real
American Founding: A Conversation," on October 11, and it's why
I'm offering you the opportunity to pre-register for the course
using this secure link:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/60870293:Wx3ATnhCN:m:3:2532013465:40983B5E0F6A06F5134E0EEB537B6F2E:r

Best
regards,

Kyle
Murnen, '09
Director
of Online Learning
Hillsdale
College

body:
I wanted to share these special moments with you.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zva9khb6t3tl7hr0tt9j5tpv5d6g6ivvhrlcsncg_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3h60o32c3h238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq7d1heirr7d1hm9qj0tbi66qbcd1jm1rr3cdkmerj79hnmmrq8cjm62qb6t9nkjhf4onkm8p6athgs5jmasbhcdq3adlke2rjdcjnmerbfcjheer32tljcorm2d30c5rj1puie1p68dhgm9j74t1hepge1d3563gbacb4spj6cc9n6mq6fclgcoq61cr4cuobapbi4no)

| |
---
| | | Friend,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z2oen3ikk84h5abs1i284p664n18upm8ukg2o0l8_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3h60o32c3h2bs "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zcufksqnlv53jam8phirdpn3qabfc6ek2fcpr6t0_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3h60o32c3h2bs "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zigp0gcvuftvgqsllpt14nd7boir3hnqvnngr85g_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3h60o32c3h2bs "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z4ah3sihohrqbktpdim4a28qjjin4r7iqe9ur9l0_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3h60o32c3h2bs "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zce0r28a01qj68klcvpoh85jcvidhgh9p49kaft8_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3h60o32c3h2bs "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zf6nteqijampogudgtcccgtvp8k4jn9er7d7qc90_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3h60o32c3h2bs "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zhbk85jt2qk1j7p5tevk0oppfrij3jv7h4kgl0ro_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3h60o32c3h2bs "I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zi72ijkb07e90acql06tjr29khtmer7r8e3og45o_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3h60o32c3h2bs "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zhpil0leak28frca7d7q0m34dfl0invhbi9lpcao_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3h60o32c3h2bs "Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z2gtgqkv6ao09r119ucigrn9g8ac8961apcfcif8_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3h60o32c3h2bs "So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far.")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z7o7nmhcq5df0eh7rk4moqv5io1em8ldm487skeg_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3h60o32c3h2bs "KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zho2j0gl2vq9h408jhjhs3spg5uk4bptdllp86h8_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3h60o32c3h2bs "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| |

---
* * *
---
| [](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zs0ahkk00glgigicm13jt8709m0v2acmj7hanif8_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3h60o32c3h2bs "All Eyes On Washington")
---
Hey, it's Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can't make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zash1nf0ki4s0fpm2bfcbh47994757bdahutm3gg_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3h60o32c3h2bs "Rush support now to be a part of history")**_.

Let's raise money and WIN,

Hi friend,
11 years ago, I was shot.
The bullet damaged the left hemisphere of my brain, where the language function sits. Ever since, Aphasia has been a part of my life. When I speak, the words are there. It’s just hard for me to get them out.
**Aphasia makes it harder for me to speak. But I have not lost my voice. **
With a lot of practice I have found new ways to communicate. Through it all, Mark has been my rock. At every step of my journey, he has been there – pushing me, supporting me, making me laugh. And now, it’s my turn to help him.
I know a thing or two about tough campaigns. And I can tell you one thing for sure: This one is going to be close.
**Super PACs and National Republicans are spending millions of dollars to help Mark’s opponent take back Arizona’s seat. So, I’m asking: **
**[$5 – or anything you can afford – will go a long way in helping Mark win re-election to continue fighting for the issues we care most about in the Senate. Together, we celebrate the hard work, innovation, justice and equality, and the many contributions of the Hispanic community to our district, state, and nation. New Mexico is the highest per-capita Hispanic state in the country, and we are the better for it.
Since the last U.S. Census numbers were released, we saw tremendous growth in Hispanic populations across New Mexico's 2nd District, particularly in the southeast. Hispanic populations will continue to grow and enrich our communities with economic growth, culture, traditions, language, and more.
NM-02, a majority Hispanic district, is home to hard-working families that are demanding change, and I’m ready to deliver for them.
That's why I'll fight to ensure that Hispanic workers, and in particular, Hispanic women, are paid equally for doing the same job. I'll fight to ensure that our families have access to affordable child care, housing, high-quality healthcare, and good-paying jobs. **When we lift up our Hispanic communities, we lift up the entire district.**

subject: What Really Happened at the TCF Center
body:
The TCF Center (now Huntington Place) is Michigan's largest absentee ballot processing center. There all of Detroit's AV ballots are counted. I spent 36 hours overseeing the process. What I saw shocked me. Ballots being overruled at the Adjudication tables, tens of thousands of unsecured ballots showing up in the middle of the night, poll challengers being locked out.
In the weeks following, hundreds of poll challengers signed affidavits as to what we witnessed and we were called liars.
In episode #3 I give an eyewitness account of what really happened at the TCF Center.

Derek,

Georgia, Derek.
And we’re up against Brian Kemp, a dangerous and extreme governor who will
stop at nothing to hold on to power. Will you invest $5 to
invest in Georgia’s future by replacing Brian Kemp with Stacey Abrams as
governor?

[ Hispanic ]Hispanic Heritage Month Festival in Gainesville (09/17/2022)

Hispanic Heritage Month Festival in Gainesville (09/17/2022)

We kicked off the second half of September with a trip to the Hispanic
Heritage Festival in Gainesville. It gave Stacey a chance to speak to
Latino communities across Georgia, who continue to inform her vision for
the future and the policies she plans to implement in the first year of
her term.

Stacey Abrams believes in One Georgia, where we all thrive regardless of
our background — and where our children are safe and surrounded by
opportunity and possibility. One Georgia means that access to health care,
housing, education and a good living is not a dream — but a given.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4397?refcode=sa_em_221003_B1_Roadshow_S1_T1_HQ_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1004&akid=10417%2E1862389%2E78eYd2 ]Will you chip in $5 or whatever amount makes sense to
help Stacey build a Georgia where all communities are given a seat at the
table?

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4397?refcode=sa_em_221003_B1_Roadshow_S1_T1_HQ_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1005&akid=10417%2E1862389%2E78eYd2 ]DONATE

[ New ]New Black Wall Street Tour in Stonecrest (09/18/2022)

New Black Wall Street Tour in Stonecrest (09/18/2022)

Next, we followed Stacey to New Black Wall Street in Stonecrest. Stacey
got to hear from Black business owners about their concerns for Georgia’s
future.

Stacey has a comprehensive plan to put money in Georgians’ pockets, create
good-paying jobs, expand minority contracting and invest in small
businesses to make Georgia the economic engine of the South.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4397?refcode=sa_em_221003_B1_Roadshow_S1_T1_HQ_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1006&akid=10417%2E1862389%2E78eYd2 ]Derek,
will you invest $5 to
build a better economic future for Georgia?

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4397?refcode=sa_em_221003_B1_Roadshow_S1_T1_HQ_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1007&akid=10417%2E1862389%2E78eYd2 ]DONATE

[ Old ]Old Nat Day in South Fulton County (09/18/2022)

Old Nat Day in South Fulton County (09/18/2022)

Finally, we stopped by South Fulton County to talk to everyday Georgians
about Stacey’s message.

There, Stacey made one thing clear: where we begin should not determine
where we finish,
Derek. Stacey’s vision is
about opportunity and tackling the barriers preventing too many Georgians
from dreaming big and rising.

We are incredibly close,
Derek. We have just 2 weeks
left until early voting is underway and this election is officially in
full swing.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4397?refcode=sa_em_221003_B1_Roadshow_S1_T1_HQ_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1008&akid=10417%2E1862389%2E78eYd2 ]And given that every vote counts in this election, that also means
that every contribution counts — no matter the size. Will you chip in
$25 — or $5 if that’s more feasible for you
— to ensure that we have the resources to secure a win for Stacey in
November?

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4397?refcode=sa_em_221003_B1_Roadshow_S1_T1_HQ_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1009&akid=10417%2E1862389%2E78eYd2 ]DONATE

Your support keeps us going. Thank you for sticking with us.

— Abrams HQ

When I started my time at the United States Military Academy, two young men invited me to a Bible study.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zat9mu1k0htsmquiasf55e0u3pdq148lccmhjvc0_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3h6cor4cdh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpqedtge1p7adjkm4qj7cbkmgor79hnmmrq8cjm62qb6t9nkjhf4onlc8o61o3gs3gncstkmjjm9chim9hm3cbhe3jb1cb3ejhm0s3m6oq3ed3icthb0puie1p68dhgm9j74t1hepge1d3563gbacb4spj6cc9n6mq6fcljcooj9cr3cuobapbi4no)

| |

| | | | | [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2ztd92i6rjt6mq4n24ctddcbu22lmcol59c2pbpbg_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3h6cor4cdh2bs)
---

Like a lot of people, I grew up going to church and had a relationship with God that wasn't especially strong. But as I grew older that changed.

When I started my time at the United States Military Academy, two young men invited me to a Bible study.

They were very intentional to me in explaining God's Word. After some study and discipleship with them, they helped me begin my walk with Christ.

**Since then, faith has been central to my life.** I keep a Bible open on my desk, and read every morning from the Good Book.

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z282qgr7b9dv28tqb1kjij4btk1mhse7uecosd68_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3h6cor4cdh2bs)
---

Like you, I am also confronted with a highly complex set of problems, and I need the wisdom to try and make the right calls. _**So I need my mind renewed with the truth of the Gospel each day.**_

Unfortunately, faith-driven judgments are few and far between in Washington. Our leaders act without moral clarity and the consequences have been devastating.

If we are to restore honesty, integrity, and morality to our government, __**[we must elect more faith-driven leaders.](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z2kl5guaole0l69dl801qco4mgs5t6a3v455dhug_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3h6cor4cdh2bs "we must elect more faith-driven leaders.")**__

---
| | [ELECT FAITH-DRIVEN LEADERS](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z79a0hae7oc2oaad69k7mtfg2j444m0odii6mfm0_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3h6cor4cdh2bs)
---

We are less than 100 days from the upcoming midterm elections, so it is critical we have the resources to elect more faith-driven leaders who love America. Time is of the essence!

If you agree, _**[please consider donating today](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zd4rjrof7ch9g576n4irt7kig1tek7g1tb8jqrg0_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3h6cor4cdh2bs "please consider donating today")**_ to support Christian conservatives who will let God be their guide - _**not self-interest**_.

God Bless,

Derek, I will veto any bill that restricts a woman’s right to choose — and it’s going to be one of the most consequential decisions our next Governor makes. ** ****[Derek, we must win this race to keep abortion safe, legal, and accessible in Pennsylvania. It is literally up to us. name: Mike Pompeo
subject: Finding Faith

body:
When I started my time at the United States Military Academy, two young men invited me to a Bible study.

| |
---
| | | | | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2znlukuskdhgglrf864c9km92nvfbvs40hkkudip8_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3h6cor4cth2bs)
---

Like a lot of people, I grew up going to church and had a relationship with God that wasn't especially strong. But as I grew older that changed.

When I started my time at the United States Military Academy, two young men invited me to a Bible study.

They were very intentional to me in explaining God's Word. After some study and discipleship with them, they helped me begin my walk with Christ.

**Since then, faith has been central to my life.** I keep a Bible open on my desk, and read every morning from the Good Book.

---
| [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zlnfnknuk1t8i4shtl2b0gjprla6vf210ngeuic0_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3h6cor4cth2bs)
---

Like you, I am also confronted with a highly complex set of problems, and I need the wisdom to try and make the right calls. _**So I need my mind renewed with the truth of the Gospel each day.**_

Unfortunately, faith-driven judgments are few and far between in Washington. Our leaders act without moral clarity and the consequences have been devastating.

If we are to restore honesty, integrity, and morality to our government, __**[we must elect more faith-driven leaders.](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zafaerufgjkfn4dsk3877vvg1bp0tqhak1i9eck0_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3h6cor4cth2bs "we must elect more faith-driven leaders.")**__

---
| | [ELECT FAITH-DRIVEN LEADERS](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z251fbs2moaq7vo1so9nr4am383cjobul55pcmu8_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3h6cor4cth2bs)
---

We are less than 100 days from the upcoming midterm elections, so it is critical we have the resources to elect more faith-driven leaders who love America. Time is of the essence!

If you agree, _**[please consider donating today](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zuqsulg01kvq66s3vm4cuo3emf1579smc1u9df10_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3h6cor4cth2bs "please consider donating today")**_ to support Christian conservatives who will let God be their guide - _**not self-interest**_.

God Bless,

Friend,

name: Ron Johnson
subject: a personal plea
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ron Johnson For Senate, Inc
body:
|
---
| | | Friend,

I have never seen the Left more aggressive and out of control as they are in the last few days and weeks. Long gone are the days of polite discourse, the days when we could have disagreements without it ending in riots and chaos. Not only is the left posting the personal addresses of SCOTUS members on Twitter, but in Washington DC, activists are giving cash to restaurants to "out" SCOTUS members if they dine in.

I knew when I announced my campaign for re-election that this would be a campaign unlike one I've ever seen before, and it has. The vitriol and slander I've seen so far this year has never been paralleled.

The days of decorum have disappeared, but can and need to return. And that's why I'm running for re-election. Democrats have let major cities become crime ridden, they are behind the rising inflation we are experiencing at the pump and grocery stores, and this is just the beginning of their mayhem.

This is not a landscape that I want our children and grandchildren growing up in. I will always fight for their future, and I hope if you stand with me in that fight you'll stand with me right now in this campaign.

I hate asking for money - it's my least favorite thing to do. But the facts are simple. Democrats across the country are gearing up to make this Wisconsin Senate race the most expensive in history in an attempt to not just defeat me, but defeat our values and beliefs.

No donation is too small. $5 makes a difference. $5 can help us reach that one undecided voter and ensure they get out and vote and keep WI red.

I know our nation's brightest days are ahead of us, but getting there isn't going to be easy. _**[We can win in November if I can count on your support right now.](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c86387%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=W3h6cL7pZY%2f%2fCxcryFIA8w&sysid=1 "Johnson1")**_

Please, Friend, our future is counting on our actions today.

Thanks for reading this email. I appreciate you and your family.

Thank you for your support,
Ron

---

body:
Abortion is top of mind | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/6dba84f93999/valerie-offers-no-solutions-in-town-hall-last-night-9065577?e=20ac8f046f)
---
| |
Dear Peter, What seems to be the most difficult issue to discuss these days? Answer: Whether or not aborting an unborn child is the right thing to do...and whether we should have a right to do it.. I'm Courtney Geels, and I'm a nurse who is running to become your Congresswoman in Washington D.C. I believe that very, very few people actually "like" the act of abortion. The vast majority of pro-choice people see in abortion a tragic-but-necessary solution to an impossible problem for the woman in crisis. And pro-life people want to avoid abortions not only to save a human life--the baby--but ALSO because of the emotional, psychological and sometimes physical damage abortion does to that same woman in crisis. It was Bill Clinton 30 years ago who said that in America, abortion should be "safe, legal, and RARE." But things have changed immensely in the last 30 years.
---
| [ ](https://courtneygeelsforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0ca724a68d4210b231de53e89&id=027036edbb&e=20ac8f046f)
---
Abortion legislations are getting scarier, and you might not be aware...
| Recently the US Supreme Court returned this decision to you and your fellow citizens. Now it's up to every state to make its own laws where abortion is concerned. I believe that all life is valuable and that the life of a baby in the womb is just as valuable as the life that carries that baby. Let me be clear, we are not arguing that life-saving efforts in the midst of medical emergencies be outlawed. This is what the left would have you believe. I want to empower women to choose life. I want to fight for the life of every human, and that every human would have a right to life. Don’t you? For truth, justice, and unity, Courtney Geels

body:
Friend, Members of the 1st District have asked me if I have served our country as my opponent has. This is my answer.
We all serve our country – some with a uniform and others without.
Q&A with Dr. Bob — "How have you served your country?"
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/friends-of-dr-bob-1 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/friends-of-dr-bob-1]
- Y ou don’t have to wear a military uniform to serve our country. Can you make a contribution right now [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/friends-of-dr-bob-1] so I can let more people know about my background of service? I want voters to rest-assured their future Congressman values duty to country.
CONTRIBUTE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/friends-of-dr-bob-1]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/friends-of-dr-bob-1 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/friends-of-dr-bob-1]
Like many nonmilitary members of our country, I serve with pride and dedication but without a uniform. Service looks different for all Americans.
Volunteering to help Veterans and working at a food bank or homeless center serves our country by fellow Americans.
Teachers serve our country because they educate America’s future.
Firefighters, and police officers, you have served your county by protecting us.
Nurses, doctors, childcare workers, and long-term care aids have all served our country through the care you render.
Farmers, workers, and business owners who treat employees well and not like commodities, you have served your country because of the ideals and principles you represent.
Informed voters, poll workers, local clerks, and anyone who participates or promotes our election process; this is service.
Like other dedicated servicemembers, I have worked overseas as a diplomat, serving my country by promoting and advancing a free, peaceful, and prosperous world.
Mothers, fathers, sisters, brothers, sons, and daughters who have lost loved-ones in America’s wars have served this country.
I have served my country as a social worker, physician, and diplomat in Pakistan, Afghanistan, Korea, North Africa, and Iraq. In addition, I have served as a volunteer, an informed voter, a law-abiding citizen, and a public health medical director during the COVID pandemic.
I have worked for the VA, at an Air Force base, and with the US State Department for nearly half of my career. [http://bit.ly/DBsCV]
I love my country, and with your help, I intend to continue serving as your next Representative in the United States Congress.
