Hillsdale professor of politics, Thomas G. West is one of the great scholars and teachers of the American Founding and the author of _The Political Theory of the American Founding and Vindicating the Founders_.

In this new course, Dr. West sits down with his former student and current professor at Hillsdale’s Graduate School of Government, David Azerrad, to reveal the truth about the American Founding.

As Dr. West explains, the Founders’ political theory is so foreign to Americans today—even to scholars and teachers of American history and politics—that the task of uncovering the truth about the Founding is like unearthing something from a “deep and long-forgotten pit.”

This course goes about this task by examining the primary arguments and decisions of the Founders, and it brings their theory to life by comparing it to the dominant views of contemporary America.

The result is an exciting, and often surprising, account of how the Founders established a free government in America and what they thought was necessary to sustain it.

That’s why we’re releasing our new free online course, “**The Real American Founding: A Conversation** ,” on October 11, and it’s why I’m offering you the opportunity to pre-register for the course using this secure link:

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/real-american-founding-preregister/](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=29ef52c8960140179348e476460b044e&_e=nQ9Em6xpEdBdNWSfJgXkIACVoawCcs9Joyzt5nn1Qztv2ROLNSxBa9HKsZROr9iKH3-sOPXHHWAyqk7H_8tzF6YMBh9eetzQNlXj3djE8ESY6CrvKtAv1dgskXFP6uwzdetctcFBdtX-Cqi7nwwjFQUbuDuXX9yurL1OyB7RaausD-wDi9-x0Hedmjb6dr6W8n2KkHELGTF4ut1uqb_HyZoyrusm3ibqWe2izXILMJAtN8vpXhhGIxAduJn7UtyJsXlpy-saioHrR_0TC4zVsZkVP2QvG_Aga-CxbAo4BUrk9sIEkJr8i2AR2110QObXL1IOjfDu8OzufEq_-KIcUoRGpDk4o2-ereTu11g1S31tST4BWSC4sKSdsp09gPYxfgSpgeDEicg5HtKjhEGNP02gBBbn3G9d0Zt6_KhMWQ0%3D)**
Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, ’09

Hillsdale College

name: V. Demings
subject: I know a thing or two about persevering, and winning
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Val Demings for U
body:
I am determined to meet this moment, win and never tire of doing good
| | |
---
Friend: Each and every day, it is not lost on me that I'm in what will undoubtedly be the most expensive race for the U.S. Senate in 2022 – a race that could decide the Senate majority and will be anything but easy.
But I know a thing or two about persevering, and _winning_ , even when the odds are stacked against me.
I've overcome plenty of adversity in my life, friend. **There is nothing easy about growing up as a poor Black girl in the segregated South.** But my family's faith, and faith in opportunity, taught me perseverance. It was my family, particularly my mother's words of "never tire of doing good, Val," that pushed me to where I am today.
I carry the spirit of her words with me even still – as I reflect on my career of service to Floridians and my path to being a candidate for U.S. Senate.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51865993/370591349/2061369689?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk4601-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZGE2MzdiZC0zYTQzLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=OChuIwDexH0dVZl_8ifjig1UrNY7coModQgSTkUxlkg=)
**There was nothing easy about being a first-generation college graduate** – nor was it easy working my way up the ranks of the Orlando Police Department. For 27 years, I served when it wasn't exactly ordinary to see a woman on the force, let alone a Black woman. But I never tired, and eventually, I became the first woman to lead my department as chief of police.
And friend, I know firsthand that there's nothing easy about winning elections in Florida. My first run for Congress was one of my toughest fights – but even in defeat I never tired, because I knew I could do good for my community. And it certainly wasn't easy to hold a lawless president – a habitual offender – to account. But I served as an impeachment manager, prosecuting Donald Trump in the Senate, because no one should be above the law.
My road to this moment was not easy. But I'm not sure that there’s anywhere except America where a little Black girl – the daughter of a maid and a janitor who grew up in the '60s South – could have a story so filled with opportunities like these. And I am determined to meet this moment, win and never tire of doing good so that anyone can have a story of opportunity.
This may be my toughest challenge yet, which is why I'm urging you – every last person reading this email – to chip in whatever you can to ensure I have the resources to defeat Marco Rubio and win in Florida: [**Please, will you give $5 or more to help me flip Florida blue and defend our Democratic Senate majority? Every dollar you give increases our ability to compete and win this tough battleground race.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51865994/370591350/2061369689?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk4601-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZGE2MzdiZC0zYTQzLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=OChuIwDexH0dVZl_8ifjig1UrNY7coModQgSTkUxlkg=)
With so much gratitude for all you do,

Val Demings

clean_body: I am determined to meet this moment, win and never tire of doing good | | | Friend: Each and every day, it is not lost on me that I'm in what will undoubtedly be the most expensive race for the U.S. Senate in 2022 – a race that could decide the Senate majority and will be anything but easy. But I know a thing or two about persevering, and winning , even when the odds are stacked against me. I've overcome plenty of adversity in my life, friend. There is nothing easy about growing up as a poor Black girl in the segregated South. But my family's faith, and faith in opportunity, taught me perseverance. It was my family, particularly my mother's words of "never tire of doing good, Val," that pushed me to where I am today. I carry the spirit of her words with me even still – as I reflect on my career of service to Floridians and my path to being a candidate for U.S. Senate. = There was nothing easy about being a first-generation college graduate – nor was it easy working my way up the ranks of the Orlando Police Department. For 27 years, I served when it wasn't exactly ordinary to see a woman on the force, let alone a Black woman. But I never tired, and eventually, I became the first woman to lead my department as chief of police. And friend, I know firsthand that there's nothing easy about winning elections in Florida. My first run for Congress was one of my toughest fights – but even in defeat I never tired, because I knew I could do good for my community. But I served as an impeachment manager, prosecuting Donald Trump in the Senate, because no one should be above the law. My road to this moment was not easy. body:
|
---
| | | Friend,

I'd like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out. I know I've been reaching out more recently, but that's only because we have less than two months until the Election and we desperately need everyone to step up.

**I hope you know me to be an honest man of integrity, so I thought I 'd take a second to walk you through why I'm running for office and why this goal means so much.**

---
| [](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e33888e5f65b444e9b2ccecb3908f881&_e=EkrOCkRmpR-S2T9PfZT9X8TogfUfw3sZu2yk1e3rDFpEgE4gENkurl-9RA3KA0iC-SDhXGyYKNsDkv8T17KvSbw8ih79-n5lqpLPzicVVG8H3Y_1cQ1BYRLoEnYAczx6O-T5fLHslmX73nhq3hySv9Lxfr0Ue3ZyMHDy855OaHHV1ZhdjSRXnsMUEmmS-x7ksoHqZk5K8VAmuXgLYurUmC2JHKIV9KoHDllS5_qRpww-O6xP69XMsG-1FF5lmwD84xnigtzVNE_2eZTIq9-WUnA8VwUKLdXn7Zju93Jrh_eyg5rU8P99tkBOTyFBK65F1ypZw-_Xg_Yo3Ht2HpaiOnHqeK5Xhc4ueZhUbve5gY4CB9V3LD6W26Htx43OJqeqxe6Vjf5szDFDG8lel2_ltvGDnem00tp20sHkvIauF3g6G35NdFf65XD2KXTntjq5 "2")
---
_My parents on their Wedding Day._
This is a photo of my parents on their wedding day. Thankfully, they came to America before the murderous dictator Fidel Castro came to power and turned Cuba to a dangerous socialist wasteland. After my parents saw what he had done to their homeland, they decided to stay put in America and get to work to achieve the American Dream they came to realize.

---
| [](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e33888e5f65b444e9b2ccecb3908f881&_e=EkrOCkRmpR-S2T9PfZT9X8TogfUfw3sZu2yk1e3rDFpEgE4gENkurl-9RA3KA0iC-SDhXGyYKNsDkv8T17KvSbw8ih79-n5lqpLPzicVVG8H3Y_1cQ1BYRLoEnYAczx6O-T5fLHslmX73nhq3hySv9Lxfr0Ue3ZyMHDy855OaHHV1ZhdjSRXnsMUEmmS-x7ksoHqZk5K8VAmuXgLYurUmC2JHKIV9KoHDllS5_qRpww-O6xP69XMsG-1FF5lmwD84xnigtzVNE_2eZTIq9-WUnA8VwUKLdXn7Zju93Jrh_ef-OT8OUk1g7WYD2to8O3Ok5B0ILxc10yFwc5T2PmLndozu4watipdlzmTw27CQq4FbLka5YW5X0yYpFKlrlD9Q8Q_6hXgchnQQwr4QTXoKcqntPfAYshbLbc-fE0sH3dMb9mOwevRHRvZaHIchmCY "1")
---
_My sister, Veronica, our mother, and me at graduation._
Eventually, my sister and I became first generation college graduates, and while we had to take on student loans to do so, we knew the work ethic our parents instilled would help us pay them down once we graduated.

I met my wife Jeanette in college and we got married in 1998. We started our beautiful family of four kids: Amanda, Daniella, Anthony, and Dominick. We eventually adopted two dogs, Winston and Arthur (who I found with my laptop typing some emails to you recently...).

---
| [](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e33888e5f65b444e9b2ccecb3908f881&_e=EkrOCkRmpR-S2T9PfZT9X8TogfUfw3sZu2yk1e3rDFpEgE4gENkurl-9RA3KA0iC-SDhXGyYKNsDkv8T17KvSbw8ih79-n5lqpLPzicVVG8H3Y_1cQ1BYRLoEnYAczx6O-T5fLHslmX73nhq3hySv9Lxfr0Ue3ZyMHDy855OaHHV1ZhdjSRXnsMUEmmS-x7ksoHqZk5K8VAmuXgLYurUmC2JHKIV9KoHDllS5_qRpww-O6xP69XMsG-1FF5lmwD84xnigtzVNE_2eZTIq9-WUnA8VwUKLdXn7Zju93Jrh_fV1ii5Kgd36xc1w0BnvT5vw_dhMHrv6Qmj4Q3j6Wi5EUF4752giqiazII-Pzrf7oFlhVRCGsI3p5axi2xFm4KQGypZVJwcfKXu69bIVna9IMYbZ8GY9LHhNqGEzWEQyD0ZRp_PuwUHs4fUkmutPkB3 "3")
---
_My wife, Jeanette, my daughter, Amanda, and me, circa 2000._
All jokes aside, being a father to my wonderful kids is by far my favorite and most important job, and I will never take that for granted.

I first ran for Senate because I saw what Barack Obama and Joe Biden's policies were doing to families like mine. More families were living paycheck to paycheck at the expense of tax-and-spend Democrats. My parents taught me to work if I wanted to make a change, so that's exactly what I did.

My dad never got to see me become a U.S. Senator in the country he immigrated to in order to make a better life for us, but I carry his work ethic and family values with me every day in the Senate to honor him, and now, I'm teaching my kids exactly what he taught me.

---
| [](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e33888e5f65b444e9b2ccecb3908f881&_e=EkrOCkRmpR-S2T9PfZT9X8TogfUfw3sZu2yk1e3rDFpEgE4gENkurl-9RA3KA0iC-SDhXGyYKNsDkv8T17KvSbw8ih79-n5lqpLPzicVVG8H3Y_1cQ1BYRLoEnYAczx6O-T5fLHslmX73nhq3hySv9Lxfr0Ue3ZyMHDy855OaHHV1ZhdjSRXnsMUEmmS-x7ksoHqZk5K8VAmuXgLYurUmC2JHKIV9KoHDllS5_qRpww-O6xP69XMsG-1FF5lmwD84xnigtzVNE_2eZTIq9-WUnA8VwUKLdXn7Zju93Jrh_eBY0YGwTBjUjXwdp49waPnXSAuM4genVi7Io9XgPOoh7H6xxoaG8kyAppb10TILP2ta4D7jIcl9muieIkYJkyxkzT0gIPkUSpTeTqAO51_IPE0ynt_Z63mKD0Iwy0aeZGWRRb9ZtAP5g7qusRj7Xto "4")
---
_Campaigning for president in 2015 with my beautiful family._
After seeing the dysfunction in Washington firsthand, I decided to run for President so I could bring my passion for America to the White House. My loving family was right by my side, and I couldn't have been more grateful for their support.

I wanted to stop Hillary Clinton at all costs, and eventually, that meant dropping out of the race and working with Donald Trump to win. Throughout his term, we worked on pro-family and pro-veteran bills to make America great and restore the American Dream.

---
| [](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e33888e5f65b444e9b2ccecb3908f881&_e=EkrOCkRmpR-S2T9PfZT9X8TogfUfw3sZu2yk1e3rDFpEgE4gENkurl-9RA3KA0iC-SDhXGyYKNsDkv8T17KvSbw8ih79-n5lqpLPzicVVG8H3Y_1cQ1BYRLoEnYAczx6O-T5fLHslmX73nhq3hySv9Lxfr0Ue3ZyMHDy855OaHHV1ZhdjSRXnsMUEmmS-x7ksoHqZk5K8VAmuXgLYurUmC2JHKIV9KoHDllS5_qRpww-O6xP69XMsG-1FF5lmwD84xnigtzVNE_2eZTIq9-WUnA8VwUKLdXn7Zju93Jrh_dMhx_PE6sgKqCnXBOA3YVXPpBItBNsiHUDKfjrI6FIr6f7kPntORxqtV_jaZZjRxrjZN377mvZ1Wjk5dusiQ9NfNM5Zz851LOUxEmabxsX4Pc3vhdIAGI-N11DB1S8YkK0GDvVRwu96SwLweiBIJ2u "5")
---
_On the campaign trail in August 2022. _

We’re ramping up even more in the few weeks we have left.
#
Today is our official Get Out The Vote (GOTV) kickoff.
We know that we need historic voter turnout, which is why we’re building the largest GOTV program in Texas history.
[**We’re going to share our strategy with you in a moment. But first, if you’re ready to fuel our GOTV efforts in the 36 days we have left until the election, will you pitch in and make a gift here?**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20221003-1._VV6Kv&refcode=ema20221003-210757&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=210757%2E444211%2EAC70v7)
This year _isn’t_ normal, for three big reasons:
**First, Greg Abbott has repeatedly failed Texas over the span of eight long years.** And Texans have noticed: a majority of Texans believe our state is heading in the wrong direction and disapprove of the job Greg Abbott is doing. A whopping 82% of Texans disagree with Abbott outlawing abortion beginning at conception with no exceptions for rape or incest.
**Second, Texas is changing.** Ten years ago, President Obama lost Texas by nearly 16 points. Six years ago, Hillary Clinton lost Texas by 9 points. Two years ago, Joe Biden lost Texas by 6 points.
**That’s a 10-point swing in the span of a decade — that’s huge!**
There are about 7 million voters who we believe are likely to vote for Beto (which is why it’s so important for us to reach out to them and to convince them to vote). To compare, when Greg Abbott got re-elected in 2018, he got just under 4.7 million votes. So we know we can win this, which brings us to our final point:
**Third, we’re building the largest GOTV program in Texas history.** In 2018, Beto inspired thousands of Texans across our state to volunteer — and they knocked on **3 million doors** and made **20 million calls.** It was the largest organizing program in Texas history, and it brought Beto just 2.6 points shy of winning.
**This year, we’ve _already_ knocked on twice as many doors and made twice as many calls as in 2018.** We’ve already far eclipsed the amount of voter contact we did that year — and we’re ramping up even more in the few weeks we have left.
[**But we’re going to need grassroots donations from supporters like you to fuel that work through Election Day. So please chip in whatever you can and help us build the largest GOTV program in Texas history.**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20221003-1._VV6Kv&refcode=ema20221003-210757&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=210757%2E444211%2EAC70v7)

Team Beto

body:
We need your signature. YEARS of organizing could come down to this.? BREAKING: The Senate has voted to pass major climate investments. Now, the House of Representatives must act.
After months of negotiating and years of organizing, a cost-saving deal that makes overdue investments in clean energy, justice, and jobs has passed the Senate. These climate provisions will build a more affordable, healthy, just, and equitable future.
Democrats hold a slim majority in the House ? we needeveryone to take action right now to bring this important legislation over the finish line.

GOAL: 10,000 ACTIONS TELL THE HOUSE:
PASS THE INFLATION?
REDUCTION ACT? https://links.messages.lcv. ? ?
? Peter,

After the Senate?s historic vote,we are just one hurdle away from the most important investment in climate action, clean energy, and environmental justice in our nation?s history ? an investment?that will put us on a path to reduce carbon emissions by roughly 40 percent by 2030.

The House of Representatives will vote next, and there?s no margin for error ? we cannot afford to lose any votes.?

Supporters of the environment hold just a slim majority, meaning thatjust a few defections could sink the bill.

Even though there is bipartisan support amongst voters for this package, corporate polluters like the Koch Network are spendingmassive sums of money to pressure lawmakers to vote no. We need to demonstrate the environmental community?s overwhelming support for this historic investment in clean energy and environmental justice.

We?ve overcome more than a year of negotiations ? and we?ve been advocatingnonstop to get to this point. We can?t let up now. If your representative doesn?t hear from us, we could see this deal fall apart.

The planet cannot afford to lose a single vote. Urge your representative in the House to pass a budget reconciliation bill with significant investments in clean energy, energy security, and environmental justice. https://links.messages.lcv.

Between increasingly devastating climate-fueled extreme weather events, high energy prices, and rising inflation, this transformational, cost-saving climate legislation is urgently needed now.?

We?re talking about hundreds of billions of dollars to ramp up clean energy production in the United States AND a plan to lower the costs of prescription drugs.This bill will save families money, reduce greenhouse gas emissions, and help tackle inflation ? and it?s all paid for by the ultra-wealthy and corporations.

Wefinally have the chance to make bold climate investments that protect our health, cut dangerous pollution, advance environmental justice, help reduce energy costs, and create good-paying clean energy jobs.

President Biden has already promised to sign these climate investments into law. But first, the House must pass the bill to send it to his desk.?

Don't wait? take action now.?Submit your letter of support to the House?before it?s too late. We need to?reach 10,000 letters demanding historic climate investments that will make life better for people and protect the planet. https://links.messages.lcv.

We're?so close,?Peter. But we aren't?over the finish line yet. Thank you for helping us get there together.?

Onward,

Sara Chieffo
Vice President, Government Affairs

| | Dear Friend of Liberty, Michael and Chantell Sackett have been fighting for 15 years to build a home on the private property they own near Priest Lake in Bonner County, Idaho. It's not for the usual reasons like a lack of building supplies or unresponsive contractors. It's because the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) declared that their land is a wetland. But here's the kicker. The Sacketts' land is not wet. There's no water on it! Still, the government is going after them. And if the couple doesn't comply with the EPA's outlandish regulations, they could face fines up to $32,500 _per day_! The Sacketts have been dragged through the courts for years fighting for their property rights--**and yours**. Now, their case will be argued before the U.S. Supreme Court. And MSLF has lent them support in their fight against this blatant government overreach. That's why I'm emailing you today with a special request. I'm hoping you will stand with the Sacketts and show them you support their fight by signing our petition today. If the EPA is allowed to trample the lives of private citizens like the Sacketts with no opposition, there's no telling who could be next. But your voice today will push back against this injustice and show the government that you stand for freedom and the private property rights of every American citizen. **Please sign the petition below declaring your desire to stand against this blatant overreach by the EPA.**
* I am standing for the private property rights of Michael and Chantell Sackett.
* I am standing against unelected bureaucracies that threaten the rights of individual citizens.
* I am asking the U.S. Supreme Court to rule against the EPA's blatant government overreach.

Please sign our petition right now at this secure link: **[https://mslegal.org/subscribe/sackett-petition/](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=af3352d8d39a4b238224c51d93085d97&_e=PCNzE-35lhBgHQfPrSDLKIZDVYZTPEzux7CDrPes3sHfN-POwtBiFfrl7mCmYKbDAW0Vsk8RzYugYX0BJtfG-Km9NjwdZ0nEUNnwCt9m4HkPJXgYxwAPNBKF4wFyyb7PHO7Obks9y-cDImNU8kmNmGGWRAWR3oA2poPydXWc8iOJPQUQlzrK5yA1CdFVFwlMy2wW01hjDdwfBkI72HtyPRo9EUWLJpU9lVJpB7cRSb3DPvgFNDlRa8DqperbQfRFO9KEpcAe-p7-9YBr77PwVVrih53A0r9iR63R3qyedA_31JUkiudCR35OEnOg1JPyAtWRQamo_HELW9LafzRMFr98uhV_Ckp8_EtFl7tXrUc%3D)** For Liberty! subject: Donald Trump
body:
Just 36 days before the election, Trump and his allies are now using MAGA Inc., a new super PAC | | |
---
| | This just in - Trump and his allies just launched a new super PAC called MAGA Inc. to dump money into swing states and help Trump-endorsed candidates up and down the ballot in the final stretch of this election. We’re concerned, and here’s why:
* Trump has already dumped $3 million into the states to support his state legislative candidates.
* He’s hosted multiple rallies in critical states like Arizona, Wisconsin, and Michigan over the past year.

subject: Elections have consequences – and there’s a lot on the line next month

body:
So much depends on who wins in November
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51871770/370612072/1144435635?refcode=nw_em_templateheader&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNjAzNTQzMi00NjQzLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=fva_nQRtVUy-RqXhXvsKn0LWqIILRaSnf-jlsclgI9c=)

Team,

My parents taught me that elections have consequences from a very young age.

Whether or not you can buy a home, pay your mortgage, put food on the table, pay for your prescriptions, or support your family, all depend on who wins elections.

**I’m running for Governor because I know that Ohioans' livelihoods are determined by who wins in November. I’m dedicated to building an Ohio where everyone can succeed.**

**[Can you chip in $5 to my campaign today to help me win this race?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51871771/370612073/-1862803865?refcode=nw_em_221003_1_t2&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNjAzNTQzMi00NjQzLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=fva_nQRtVUy-RqXhXvsKn0LWqIILRaSnf-jlsclgI9c=)**

Growing up in a union family, I know what it’s like to hit hard times. When my dad lost his job, we worried about how we’d be able to afford our groceries and pay our rent. My opponent, _millionaire_ Mike DeWine, doesn’t understand what it’s like to think “we might not be able to get by this month.”

He also doesn’t care that his dangerous actions as governor have repercussions for Ohioans. He has – and will continue to – put his wealthy GOP donor friends before us, leaving working families to struggle alone.

I know now what I knew as a kid – that elections have consequences. I know that my actions as governor will have a direct impact on you, and I’ll always work to make sure Ohioans can not only get by, but thrive.

**[We can’t let Mike DeWine hurt Ohioans anymore. Please, pitch in $5 to my campaign now before our upcoming fundraising deadline on Wednesday so we can reach our goal, win in November, and fight for a better future for Ohio.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51871772/370612074/-1862803865?refcode=nw_em_221003_1_t2&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyNjAzNTQzMi00NjQzLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=fva_nQRtVUy-RqXhXvsKn0LWqIILRaSnf-jlsclgI9c=)**

Onward,

Nan Whaley

Hillsdale professor of politics, Thomas G. West is one of the great scholars and teachers of the American Founding and the author of _The Political Theory of the American Founding and Vindicating the Founders_.

In this new course, Dr. West sits down with his former student and current professor at Hillsdale’s Graduate School of Government, David Azerrad, to reveal the truth about the American Founding.

As Dr. West explains, the Founders’ political theory is so foreign to Americans today—even to scholars and teachers of American history and politics—that the task of uncovering the truth about the Founding is like unearthing something from a “deep and long-forgotten pit.”

This course goes about this task by examining the primary arguments and decisions of the Founders, and it brings their theory to life by comparing it to the dominant views of contemporary America.

The result is an exciting, and often surprising, account of how the Founders established a free government in America and what they thought was necessary to sustain it.

That’s why we’re releasing our new free online course, “**The Real American Founding: A Conversation** ,” on October 11, and it’s why I’m offering you the opportunity to pre-register for the course using this secure link:

| | | | | Peter, [**Sign this petition and comments will be directly added. Click "start writing" to get going and remember to let them know: We do not approve of this offshore drilling proposal and we will not let it happen.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tda6d62f0-9edf-4ee2-8da3-0d0704b07942/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) When President Biden was campaigning two years ago, he promised no new oil drilling leases. But now, the U.S. Department of Interior and Bureau of Ocean Energy Management (BOEM) have a **five-year plan for offshore drilling** – one new lease in Alaska and up to 10 in the Gulf of Mexico over the next 5 years. This lost-promise and major giveaway to Big Oil would devastate habitats, threaten local economies, and put coastal communities at further risk for even more ecological disasters.** ** Opening our coasts to offshore drilling jeopardizes health, tourism, and fishing jobs, and marine life – particularly in the Gulf of Mexico, where impacts of the [Deepwater Horizon](https://default.salsalabs.org/T47a02719-da4d-4e0b-b54e-38c6a07178af/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) disaster can be felt to this day.

It’s important that voters hear from the candidates who seek to serve them in Congress.

**That’s why I’ve already agreed to four televised debates against Congresswoman Elise Stefanik — but she has refused to accept any and all invitations.**

Stefanik and her team claim I’m “colluding” with local media outlets as their excuse for not owning up to her horrible record in front of the people she vowed under oath to represent.

Listen, just like other entrenched politicians, Elise Stefanik is blaming the media and pushing unhinged claims to avoid accountability for her actions. [**Our communities deserve better and we deserve to hear from our Representatives at every turn. Will you chip in $3 to help me hit my $7,000 daily fundraising goal ensuring we win in November and return public service back to NY-21? »**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51872115/370613353/-49260804?amount=3&amounts=3,10,25&refcode=MCFC_20221003_EMDF_E1_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMjU0MzM0Zi00NzQzLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_e6cEFXbzAbDNsl-cLHdLfO-I3A0YCr5Vjjb3IBBFwI=) | [Chip in $3 to defeat ultra-MAGA Republican Elise Stefanik »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51872116/370613354/-49260804?amount=3&amounts=3,10,25&refcode=MCFC_20221003_EMDF_E1_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMjU0MzM0Zi00NzQzLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=_e6cEFXbzAbDNsl-cLHdLfO-I3A0YCr5Vjjb3IBBFwI=)

I’m not surprised Stefanik is afraid to face the people of NY-21 — she knows she has turned her back on us in favor of advancing her own political career.

After years of putting party before country, facing me in a debate could ruin Stefanik’s re-election chances:
* **How would Elise Stefanik explain why she didn’t support the PACT Act?** It ensures veterans exposed to toxic burn pits will receive the crucial healthcare they deserve.
* **How would Elise Stefanik explain why she didn’t support the Inflation Reduction Act?** It lowers the cost of prescription drugs, health insurance, and energy.

Stefanik opposed these bills that would improve the lives of people in NY-21 and across the country because party leadership told her she should – _putting party before country._

Peter,

The Real Clear Politics polling average has me behind by 0.3% in the Georgia Senate race with less than 6 weeks until the election.

Since more than $50 million has been spent against me in false attack ads, it's remarkable that this race is as close as it is - and _it speaks volumes about how disillusioned Georgians are with Democrats._

JD

| | | | | [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001XQXGjP-QTSlS248U6AHLpmM0Fx8QmaN2SVl6j7ZN-iw4t2jcRhzZ_pR_5H4MQQwcphCMYXyPAUAyDkBfshvDI9JssHWyJaqXXolf_wOm1WWMtLcsYANca6LPBVNDcfrqbVAdzxU-Tz-Ps6annBqREhz6RYkXhgVR0TSohobDrN6Z735j9ZSdraIX57kl_6e-bzDgSOhr15f2n5ApFO_CL_jwPDOnZMACMPdvd0-xX2Y=&c=i6CKG6_bt_CJYXsdVAFVShZxZL914lwTGs4v-7ko6ep-AxgukDNfWw==&ch=J84xUG_MY3FMKL98rYptkfdZrfZ_tzrwdv27MZ59dWlfDSX1H3YFeA==)

| Peter,
Yesterday, I went head-to-head with Steve Sisolak on the debate stage and challenged his failed record as Governor directly.
The contrast between us could not have been more stark... Here are two important takeaways to keep in mind as this race draws even more attention:
1) Steve Sisolak fully embraced the policies of Joe Biden.
That's right - even though this President has been a disaster by every measure, with inflation spiraling out of control and hurting everyday Nevadans, our Governor seriously called him a "very good President" who has "done very well" in office. These two are tied at the hip, Peter.
Sisolak even went so far as to try to explain his and Biden's reckless spending. He was trying to convince you that it had nothing to do with the inflation surge. He's simply out-of-touch with everyday Nevadans.
Do we really want four more years of Sisolak and Biden's reckless policies?
---

| 2) Steve Sisolak doubled down on dangerous policies that are hurting our kids, teachers, and families.
When he was asked if he would repeal his dangerous policies like AB 168, Sisolak made it clear where he stands... He said "No" to keeping us safe.
Peter, ever since this bill was passed, school violence has spiked, 27% of teachers have felt threatened by a student, and crimes like sexual assault within CCSD have gone up by 46%!

clean_body: Yesterday, I went head-to-head with Steve Sisolak on the debate stage and challenged his failed record as Governor directly. | | | | | == | Peter, Yesterday, I went head-to-head with Steve Sisolak on the debate stage and challenged his failed record as Governor directly. The contrast between us could not have been more stark... Here are two important takeaways to keep in mind as this race draws even more attention: 1) Steve Sisolak fully embraced the policies of Joe Biden. That's right - even though this President has been a disaster by every measure, with inflation spiraling out of control and hurting everyday Nevadans, our Governor seriously called him a "very good President" who has "done very well" in office. These two are tied at the hip, Peter. Sisolak even went so far as to try to explain his and Biden's reckless spending. He was trying to convince you that it had nothing to do with the inflation surge. He's simply out-of-touch with everyday Nevadans. Do we really want four more years of Sisolak and Biden's reckless policies? | | == | 2) Steve Sisolak doubled down on dangerous policies that are hurting our kids, teachers, and families. When he was asked if he would repeal his dangerous policies like AB 168, Sisolak made it clear where he stands... He said "No" to keeping us safe. Peter, ever since this bill was passed, school violence has spiked, 27% of teachers have felt threatened by a student, and crimes like sexual assault within CCSD have gone up by 46%! School safety will not improve if Steve Sisolak is reelected to be our Governor - he just said so himself. Why is Steve unwilling to put the safety of teachers and students ahead of his political agenda? | | == | Our Governor made it loud and clear where he stands, Peter - and it's NOT with our economy, schools, and safety. The good news? New polls have us AHEAD of Steve Sisolak right now, even with all the millions he is pouring into this race! | == | We are winning debates and leading in polls right now, Peter. But if we can't keep up that momentum over this final stretch, we could fall short to this Governor who has abandoned our economy and safety. == | | == | | == | | == | | == | | == | | == | | == | Thank you for keeping up the fight, Sheriff Joe Lombardo | | Lombardo for Governor | == | == == == | | | | | | | Lombardo for Governor | P.O. They both have a history of using their prominence and fame to make the world a better place, and both have contributed a great deal to Vermont. Here’s what they said in their endorsement: “We are proud to endorse Brenda Siegel to be Vermont’s next Governor. Brenda is fiercely committed to creating a Vermont that works for all of us. She is a social and economic justice champion and has long led on criminal justice reform, housing and the overdose crisis. It is essential that we have a Governor who is prepared to lead proactively in a moment when liberties are being eroded and we know that Brenda Siegel will be a Governor we can count on. Vermonters need a Governor that will prioritize our values, bring diverse and underrepresented voices to the table, and work to create a more equitable future. We need her experience, leadership, and skills on the 5th floor. We are excited to have a Vermont that has Brenda in partnership with every day Vermonters. Vote on or before November 8th for a brighter future for our children and the Vermont we all love so much.” | We’re excited to see all of Vermont’s champions and leaders rallying around Brenda! body:
I wanted to share these special moments with you.
[View this message in your browser](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z8dn6ovcrkac9ve4bc3p74q77dbqilihs431am60_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3j60o72c1h238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuij791lmkp79dhk6eojacpl6er7actl6tr779hnmmrq8cjm62qb6t9nkjhf4onh69rj4tj0e8qjfdtm6hh63dr365omct3lm9in0or2e1q34cph61r38cph6kq6fduie1p64pjgm9j71p5jcdjr4t366phb6o37mth6cd30m9j61o5lcdge1d9h66qj3dbi4no)

| |
---
| | | Friend,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z4in38p3ngaljp5s0ephlud44ptubbvjj92na4a0_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3j60o72c1h2bs "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z9ane3jvugau2l16sfr9ofm6snc5stvhke31906o_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3j60o72c1h2bs "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zhvsnqvastnaq4d9rhol4f10j391tvdmkaqehqio_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3j60o72c1h2bs "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zmucgcdp1eevcvbun9h8dj6uuvhi4ateimige6k0_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3j60o72c1h2bs "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z9us3gq5etdm75hadp1958g38rfvpa3qbpdtrla8_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3j60o72c1h2bs "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zhiv3pp8pj9q04kp1anq2l0jg42hsr4o74bvrr00_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3j60o72c1h2bs "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z1cmf6ai52p2b4kc0u6g035ms4ufuinagk3c4cj0_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3j60o72c1h2bs "I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z7j4vob1ja8s00ne6ap0f951f62ch181lr076bf0_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3j60o72c1h2bs "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zbeiresck103qrbf7fde452ppdtu70qhs3dpjhu8_rp22sh2s8i66or1c3j60o72c1h2bs "Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

name: Jamaal Bowman
subject: We need more Justice Democrats in Congress
body:
We built a people-powered campaign from the bottom up – and won.
#
Peter,
As the longtime principal of a public middle school in the Bronx, I saw real need in our community that wasn’t being addressed by our absent representative. **That’s when Justice Democrats recruited me to run for Congress myself.**
Most people tried to tell us victory was impossible. They said that even if we could convince voters, we could never compete with the millions that Super PACs would throw at us. But they were all wrong.
**Thanks to the tireless work of the team at Justice Democrats, we won an unprecedented race and made history right here in the Bronx.**
**[I’m asking you today: will you support Justice Democrats with a donation so they can continue to invest in historic campaigns and send more progressive, working people like me to Congress?](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/116751?refcode=em20221003-25395&t=1&akid=25395%2E1203867%2E_lnOw3)**
**[Contribute](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/116751?refcode=em20221003-25395&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=25395%2E1203867%2E_lnOw3)**
When almost half of all members of Congress are millionaires, we know the odds are stacked against working people. That’s why Justice Democrats’ work is so important – **they help level the playing field for working class candidates who deserve a real shot at representing our communities.**
In just a few years, Justice Democrats have transformed Democratic politics and shown that regular people can run for office and win. And we can do it all without a cent of corporate money or compromising on our core values.
Cycle after cycle, JD helps elect new progressives who go on to fight for the lifesaving policies we need. **We have to continue to recruit, support, and elect new Justice Democrats who will join our Squad and represent the movement in Congress.**
The bigger the Squad, the bigger and better our victories will be. And at this turning point in history, we need all the progressive power we can get.
**[I know firsthand the difference JD can make in critical races, which is why I want to make sure they have all the resources they need to elect the next generation of Justice Democrats. Will you join me and donate to JD today?](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/116751?refcode=em20221003-25395&t=21&akid=25395%2E1203867%2E_lnOw3)**
Remember: we’re all in this fight together.
Peace and love,
Jamaal Bowman

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20221003-25395-footer&t=22&refcode2=25395_1203867__lnOw3&akid=25395%2E1203867%2E_lnOw3)**

body:
There’s this notion nowadays that just because an idea is popular, it must be true.

| | | [](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=d534f5297d9444da82e6e08e59d5992d&_e=93wHPeeWQy3tCmvTN701bj1oyWmvGqAwR75bBJUa2WJCAkbXwIIP3huUNiF6PnjV404OJd161u2elDQon9XMLJDDXGFyZH9eOLZwPG7Pm_WhnGHslmPN8VCXQhuTl9WQd88LcDqiCdWq4kQDOlMghwqftyeGFuS2dhyvBBUD7uxWOlWC5_Sc7uckGGBzAhdz4xDexkhKVLpTVZjP7vXpyJVt2IvWB-fmAOQkyrQJqrak4q6KycEO35Rx_yeTx3FylriRf2p7v4uYY7rBtXaDurMOwIz9VB30ojlP4fM8Rnts_wLFYaiwmEpY1GlTx1mmIYuUHgELmPlix6AmyUK1D-66lknb1U_5Y1pZ7vFEcoh86vpa9J65OfynNhgHKHMm)

| | Dear Friend, There's this notion nowadays that just because an idea is popular, it must be true.

It's a narrative that you'll often see pushed by a dysfunctional media or toxic culture. And as long as the idea is considered "correct" by the "right" people like TV talking heads, celebrities, or the masses on social media, the general public believes it.

subject: My dad used to wake me up each morning with these words:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warnock for Georgia
body:
| | |
---
Friend,

My dad used to wake me up at 6 a.m. each morning and say, "Put your shoes on, son. Get ready. There's something for you to do."
He was many things throughout his life: a veteran, a small businessman, and a preacher. He spent his days fixing junk cars that other folks had discarded – and then on Sundays, he preached to folks who felt discarded.
One of my last memories of my dad was calling him the day Barack Obama was inaugurated as the 44th president of the United States. I heard the pride and joy in his voice – the ways in which he saw the arc of history bending a little closer toward justice. Two years later, my dad was gone. As the senior pastor at Dr. King's church, I had the sad duty and honor of eulogizing him.

My father taught me so much – from the meaning of hard work to the value of serving others – and I bring these lessons with me wherever I go, including to the U.S. Senate. He's a big reason why I'm in this fight to build a better, brighter future for all people, not just the lucky few.
**But keeping up this fight in Washington won't be easy:_NPR_ is calling me one of the most vulnerable Democratic senators up for reelection – in a race that experts say could decide Senate control. The only way I can fight back and defend my critical seat is if folks like you chip in now. **

| | | Friend,

First, Joe Biden told voters, “you ain’t black” if they were still deciding between voting for him or Donald Trump.

Then, a liberal MSNBC guest called Winsome Sears 'The Black Mouth Of White Supremacy' when she became the first woman elected to the office of Lt. Governor in Virginia as a Black Republican.

Now, the co-host of “The View,” Sunny Hostin, recently said on air that she “doesn’t understand black Republicans,” and that a black Republican is “an oxymoron.”

I’ve seen more than my share of vicious opposition from “liberals” who want to tear me down simply because my life story is a direct rebuke to everything they’re constantly saying about how our nation is “irredeemably racist” and how the “deck is stacked against” people like me.

I am the first African American Republican to serve in the U.S. Senate since 1979. And I am the first African American EVER to represent South Carolina in the U.S. Senate.

Friend, Democrats’ divisiveness only hurts our country, and it is deeply saddening to see.

**[I’m reaching out to you today because I know I can count on you to show the Democrats that the GOP is indeed the big tent party - and we won’t let their divisiveness tear our nation down.](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=1e00f900f72c401e81634fd3eb5caaee&_e=5G0awV9905scDeoAnVsLMfmll4Es97TkHCsg4Y7nwgRuEb8Gu4P0BAdYGGWHpKNO5ZcRxPdwURPX54m-NlQqa-_nMgTs7HEk7rtYdDkTVmy7yNzgpAnghkui6mAfC1cCDvwQlxsczPMjEBgKZ-KFJmYEsqIPVtvy4jxe9t_CoCUbMBtiqhplTFvQsEbpNDen-piW547px8umP-W_MNTJjUdU75CmxqDgjrjHD3sx2RQYzgKqE1YcsFF0p0kFfVfcYkX4ZvihSjiAGadicydXKBFL8qxFGMSia_l0-4g2-O0B1_M580uxhoJl3WYvUOt0_wNAuVSWnVPSJJTtFD2j--5Bn9cqEDHSsFqVxWDsGYgnoStTx_RKTQoOdYrqcPTOoMBoH45VPA3PcF7aPGKnfPmvAaJGL1ZFTr_H0t65px3X_rUPdPpIX-BCxzo89n5XxgXPbM9qvLo0Mz3lvw3yEij9RnYsjFmWrkVxJBAEl5k%3D "I’m reaching out to you today because I know I can count on you to show the Democrats that the GOP is indeed the big tent party - and we won’t let their divisiveness tear our nation down.")**

name: Team Jayapal
subject: Quick question for Peter
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
In a fight as important as this one, our stories have real power.
#
“I don’t go to the doctor unless I absolutely have to because it's so expensive” should never be said in the richest country in the world. People shouldn’t be saddled with insurmountable debt just for getting sick. We need Medicare for All. **[Today we’re asking: Peter, what would Medicare for All mean for you, your family, and your loved ones?](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/m4a-stories?source=em20221003&t=1&akid=1676%2E420207%2EFT7UqL)** **[Share Your Story »](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/signup/m4a-stories?source=em20221003&t=2&akid=1676%2E420207%2EFT7UqL)** In a fight as important as this one, our stories have real power. name: Brittany Pettersen
subject: Thank you so much, Team
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Brittany Pettersen for Colorado
body:
I just wanted to send you a quick note thanking you for everything you do for this campaign.

Team,

I just wanted to send you a quick note thanking you for everything you do for this campaign.

Whether you’ve donated, signed up for a volunteer shift, spread the word on social media, or simply put up with our emails (which I know are a lot!), I am so thankful for your support.

There are a lot of great candidates in tough races this year, and I don’t take it for granted that you’re directing your time and resources to this campaign here in Colorado’s 7th District.

You don’t need me to tell you that the stakes are high here. The outcome of this race will affect us all — our access to basic civil rights, our ability to live in a functioning democracy, our freedom to go about our lives without the fear of gun violence, and our economic security.

This election matters in ways that are deeply personal to all our families. It’s why I’m fighting so hard to win — because making life better for regular families here in Colorado is worth the challenge of going up against GOP super PACs that are ready to spend millions of dollars attacking me.

We’ve got five weeks to go until Election Day, and I promise you that I will do everything I possibly can before then to win this seat and defend our House majority. It’s going to be extremely close, and Republicans are going to throw a lot at us — but I know that together, we can succeed.

Thank you again for everything you’re doing, and I can’t wait to see you out on the campaign trail in these final five weeks.

With gratitude,

Victory - Round 1! Thanks to all of you, Joe Manchin just suffered a
defeat of his Dirty Deal to fast-track fossil fuels! We know the industry
goons won’t give up, and we need to keep this same energy when the dirty
deal rears its ugly head again - but for now, we celebrate!

Bernie Sanders thanked our coalition for the hard work and organizing that
led to this win, and [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7677?t=1015&akid=3479%2E5885482%2ExiHyb2 ]People’s World reported on the “blitz” of our
rapid response. Our Revolution members sent thousands of calls to
legislators right up to the end.

Sens. Jeff Merkley, Ed Markey, Cory Booker, and Tammy Duckworth
joined Bernie to pledge no votes, and the deal was stripped from the
Senate bill to fund the government.

“This is a wishlist written by industry lobbyists that would gut frontline
community protections & zero-out climate steps in the Inflation Reduction
Act, OR Executive Director Joseph Geevarghese wrote in a [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7678?t=1016&akid=3479%2E5885482%2ExiHyb2 ]thread
recapping the fight. “It must be defeated.”

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7675?t=1017&akid=3479%2E5885482%2ExiHyb2 ][IMG]

Our Revolution launched this fight early, and we took the fight directly
to Capitol Hill on Tuesday!

Our coalition of frontline activists and climate advocates like Bill
McKibben spoke against the deal — which would expedite dozens if not
hundreds of some of the dirtiest fossil fuel projects every year,
including the Mountain Valley Pipeline, the emissions equivalent of adding
37 coal plants per year.

“We know this isn’t dead yet, and we’ll keep fighting,” OR National
Coordinator Hal Ginsberg told [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7679?t=1018&akid=3479%2E5885482%2ExiHyb2 ]CBS 7 News in Roanoke. “We will keep
working with our coalition, demanding senators respect the land and the
people who live here.”

Attorney General Keith Ellison and defeat his far-right extremist
opponent!

The choice is clear. Keith fought corporate price-gouging during the
pandemic and led the conviction of Derek Chauvin for the murder of George
Floyd.

While Keith works to hold corporations and the powerful accountable, his
opponent wants to defund corporate law enforcement altogether, [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7680?t=1021&akid=3479%2E5885482%2ExiHyb2 ]The
American Prospect reports.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7675?t=1022&akid=3479%2E5885482%2ExiHyb2 ][IMG]

A Board Member of Our Revolution, Keith has worked for decades to advance
democratic and criminal-justice reform and to fight corporate monopolies.

Doing the people’s work earns you powerful enemies, and Keith is in a
tough race. Can you step up to help re-elect Keith Ellison?

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7681?t=1023&akid=3479%2E5885482%2ExiHyb2 ]VOLUNTEER FOR KEITH

PRIORITY PROGRESSIVE HOUSE RACES

To hold the House, we’ll have to win priority races for progressives Jamie
McLeod-Skinner in Oregon’s 5th District and Michelle Vallejo in Texas’
15th!

Our Revolution is proud to endorse Jamie and Michelle, who are two of the
10 progressives who won primaries this year but have competitive races in
November.

Progressives like Rep. Cori Bush and Rashida Tlaib have asked Our
Revolution members to help send reinforcements to grow progressive power

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7593?t=1025&akid=3479%2E5885482%2ExiHyb2 ]DONATE TO ELECT PROGRESSIVES

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7675?t=1026&akid=3479%2E5885482%2ExiHyb2 ][IMG]

Jamie McLeod-Skinner won one of the most important races this primary
season, overcoming a barrage of spending by Big Pharma for a resounding
victory over Kurt Shrader — one of the worst Democrats in the House.

Now, in the general election, she’s up against a Republican extremist who
wants to criminalize abortion and sides with election deniers.

As Jamie said on our [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7682?t=1027&akid=3479%2E5885482%2ExiHyb2 ]National Organizing Call on Monday, “This is a
time of crisis and we need leaders who care about people, planet, and
democracy. It’s about accountability to the people and not
mega-corporations.”

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7675?t=1028&akid=3479%2E5885482%2ExiHyb2 ][IMG]

On Santa Clara City Council, Jamie championed renewable energy and climate
action, and on Jefferson County School Board, she developed statewide
racial justice and equity policy.

Jamie is a working-class former union member, and she’s committed to
serving working families and protecting our democracy.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/4972?t=1029&akid=3479%2E5885482%2ExiHyb2 ]HELP US MAKE CALLS FOR JAMIE AND OUR OTHER GREAT CANDIDATES!

toss-up district, where she won by just 35 votes in the primary!

“South Texas has been used as a political backdrop for radical Republicans
to use as their pawns,” Michelle said on our [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/7682?t=1031&akid=3479%2E5885482%2ExiHyb2 ]Live Organizing Call.

corporate interests and the radical right agenda.”

to strengthen it with a progressive champion who puts people first.

minimum wage. She has co-founded two organizations to support community

We have two days to raise $50,000 for these efforts, and we need your help.

| [** Help Us Reach Every Undecided Voter
Chip in $10 -> **](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=b6c8041249554292b1dd591d4603ed6b&_e=1y_p6OSxbn_77QvNJzK-12J0fPpPHxILPT2uVj6Wer_lZyehNXhHwiyduDIbVZ88gW0ShgSolX1W4bWRuMIQZr1BH69X-hGYAKNy2zy1bqFwhvJAiBt_4a0Bhr2t96CSDuTpSzszeZLTX6SaNwOPNHiqz9DnRMy9w816ljeYt5q_LHej35mQiTSEB0ZTTpGAti6xiEi50_HvuExTCr_8IS7YKpM5AIiv-xWxHKf4WH3hKmUsL8ZN5OLJsGdXm_mDHkiZHj52ilqxuJY9u7kjIgJazyQcmAz5LoVBnEtBCGNSGLe3TmYvsZL-ShRhVBk4t3hSLs-5QYGo5KGOh0UNmpkmiScof2HJdNE9WcIJzxWbarCoHYCjM6fpDc-hmFsoXOhe0JeIbhl49wLkgD9hW1fjsIscZ79Z293QCscWyIPAHPvsPYCmO99pdIaKbeji)

Fellow American,

The Real Clear Politics polling average has me behind by 0.3% in the Georgia Senate race with less than 6 weeks until the election.

Since more than $50 million has been spent against me in false attack ads, it's remarkable that this race is as close as it is - and _it speaks volumes about how disillusioned Georgians are with Democrats._

subject: Derek — this is an email about a fascinating case I tried as a young prosecutor. It involved someone doing Russia’s bidding — long before Trump.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR AND AUTHORIZED BY SCHIFF FOR CONGRESS
body:
[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/62?t=1001&akid=1024%2E5257348%2E7leobE ]Adam Schiff for Congress

Derek —

Here’s something you probably don’t know about me — before I ever was in
politics, I convicted an FBI agent who was spying for Russia during the
Cold War. This is not our usual campaign email, but I think you’ll find it
interesting. Trust me.

It was a classic sex for secrets case, and the biggest case of my career.
That was, until I investigated Donald Trump and presented the case at his
first impeachment trial.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1312?c0=oct2022_abs_em.GZkB9F&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EGR_NO_20221003_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=1024%2E5257348%2E7leobE ]Before I go on (and I hope you’re going to want to read on), I want to
ask you to chip in $10 to my campaign, so I can continue holding
Republicans and anyone who seeks to undermine our democracy accountable.

Richard Miller was an FBI agent assigned to the counterintelligence
division (literally the bureau meant to combat Russian influence) in Los
Angeles in the early 1980s. Here’s him with the Russian asset who seduced
him.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=oct2022_abs_em.ghQTJ3&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EGR_NO_20221003_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=1024%2E5257348%2E7leobE ][IMG]

Miller was recruited by a Soviet emigree named Svetlana. (Why do Russian
spies always seem to be named Svetlana, I used to joke.) After coming to
the United States with her husband, she was disaffected with her new
country and longed to go back to the USSR. But defectors were viewed as
traitors by the Soviet Union and she had to earn her passage home. So, she
became a Russian intelligence asset, and Miller became her target. With
marriage and financial difficulties, Miller was an easy mark.

I’ll spare you the details of their sordid dalliances, which were
numerous. But eventually in 1984, Svetlana made her move, telling Miller
the Russians would pay him for classified documents. Miller asked for tens
of thousands in cash and gold.

He drove up to San Francisco with Svetlana, and provided a Soviet
intelligence officer at the Russian consulate with his FBI badge and a
classified FBI counterintelligence manual to prove he could deliver.

Things only escalated from there, but the FBI caught on to Miller and put
him under surveillance. Miller discovered his tail and went to his
superiors, and concocted an alibi that he was acting as a “secret double
agent.” He was arrested, confessed, and then walked back the confession.
Svetlana and her husband would later plead guilty.

Miller’s first trial was a mistrial, and his second was overturned on
appeal. We had one more chance. That’s when I was brought into the case.
At the time, I was about thirty and serving as an Assistant U.S. Attorney
in Los Angeles.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=oct2022_abs_em.ghQTJ3&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EGR_NO_20221003_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1006&akid=1024%2E5257348%2E7leobE ][IMG]

It was my first blockbuster trial. And the pressure was immense.

I prepped for months, and during that time, I came into contact with
dozens and dozens of FBI agents who had worked with Miller, but also
investigated him. It was a crash course in the Bureau’s
counterintelligence mission — which I got to know even better many years
later during my time at the Intelligence Committee, and while
investigating Trump.

The Miller trial was in 1990, so of course they gave me a pretty early
version of a cell phone — it looked like the nuclear football, it was that
big! I worked on the case all day and was on that big phone with agents
all night.

The trial commenced less than a year after the Berlin Wall came down and
just a couple of years before the Cold War finally ended. This is part of
what I told the jury in my closing argument:

“Miller had betrayed his job, his family, and the entire community that
placed its trust in his hands ... this is a case of government misconduct
and government corruption of the highest and most disturbing order.”

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=oct2022_abs_em.ghQTJ3&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EGR_NO_20221003_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1007&akid=1024%2E5257348%2E7leobE ][IMG]

The judge agreed, and the weight of the evidence was enough to convict
him. Miller was found guilty, and sentenced to twenty years in prison. He
would go down as the first FBI agent ever convicted of espionage. Sadly,
he would not be the last.

I learned a lot about the Russians during that investigation, the kind of
people they target, their tradecraft, and the vulnerabilities they look
for. They want people with access to information that is of use to them,
and they look for people they can exploit — with marital issues, or who
are motivated by greed or resentment. The Russians found a very, very good
target with Richard Miller.

I’ve made it my mission in the halls of Congress to protect our country
and our democracy, just as I did in the courtroom.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1312?c0=oct2022_abs_em.GZkB9F&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EGR_NO_20221003_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1008&akid=1024%2E5257348%2E7leobE ]That’s why I’m asking you to donate $10, or whatever amount is

| | Friend, last night on the debate stage, Mike Flood showed us who he’ll _really_ represent in Congress. **Here’s what he had to say on the issues hurting working Nebraskans:**
* When discussing gun control, he pointed to his support from the Lincoln Police Union — yet he’s voted against 5 of 6 bills that our law enforcement has supported.
* Voting to codify same-sex and interracial marriage is a “fear mongering tactic.”
* Relating to abortion, he says we should “support exceptions for life of mother, rape, and incest,” despite cosponsoring one of the most draconian abortion bans — _without exception for rape, incest, or life of the mother_ — this year in the Nebraska Legislature.
* Capping drug prices, like insulin, is “socialist.”

Mike Flood isn’t in Congress fighting for working Nebraskans like you and me — he’s using his voice _and_ his vote to support extreme agendas that don’t actually address any of the issues hurting our working families right now. **He voted against our law enforcement. He voted against same-sex and interracial marriage. He voted against contraception and abortion access. He even voted against capping prescription drug costs.** He claims to “protect our personal freedoms,” but friend, his four months in Congress prove that he's just talking out of both sides of his mouth. Last night, Patty Pansing Brooks showed Nebraskans that she’s ready to bring in a new era of leadership to Nebraska’s 1st Congressional District — one that uplifts the most vulnerable members of our community and champions our working families. **Patty is _exactly_ the kind of bipartisan leader our district needs in Washington.** **[Folks, this is our last month before the election, and we’re doing everything to hone our grassroots power before November 8. We have doors to knock, ads to run, and voters to reach before Election Day, so if you’re able, we need you to dig deep and chip in to make sure we send Patty Pansing Brooks to Congress.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51898986/370654200/333259033?amount=25&refcode=em_221003_postdebate2&sourceid=1030989&refcode2=b1eec7bb-6643-ed11-b495-002248258d38&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkxMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMWVlYzdiYi02NjQzLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sRrm_V1ZWrDawu3k7hXMmze9BVUjcy9a47cgu4jHBx4=)** _If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your contribution will be processed instantly._ | | [**DONATE $10**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51898988/370654201/333259033?amount=10&express_lane=true&refcode=em_221003_postdebate2&sourceid=1030989&refcode2=b1eec7bb-6643-ed11-b495-002248258d38&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkxMCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMWVlYzdiYi02NjQzLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sRrm_V1ZWrDawu3k7hXMmze9BVUjcy9a47cgu4jHBx4=)

clean_body: | | | Tonight, I'll take the debate stage. But my opponent won't be there. Last week, we learned that Rand Paul has declined to debate me. He won't defend his record or make his case to the people of Kentucky that he deserves reelection. Nonpartisan election analysts all have North Carolina ranked as one of the most competitive Senate races in the country.
#

Nonpartisan election analysts all have North Carolina ranked as one of the most competitive Senate races in the country. So we need to be crystal clear about what’s at stake here:
Our opponent is a corporate insider who believes abortion should be banned nationwide without exceptions and calls the January 6 insurrectionists “patriots,” and refuses to commit to accepting the results of this year’s election. He voted to overturn the 2020 election, voted against same-sex and interracial marriage, voted against climate action, and voted against capping the cost of insulin. It’s no exaggeration to say he has put our planet, our democracy, and our Constitutional rights all at risk.
Ted Budd’s record in Congress has shown us exactly what kind of Senator he would be, and you better believe he has no interest in standing up to the corporate interests and far-right billionaires backing his campaign.
There’s a reason super PACs are spending over $50 million to try to buy this seat. They have proven they are not afraid to attack Cheri with endless lies, and these corrupt insiders have no interest in stopping now. Ted Budd has proven in Congress that he’s their guy, and they will make sure he has every possible financial advantage.
It may not seem like $3 is enough to go up against $50 million in outside Republican spending, but it’s not just your $3. A lot of people are donating what they can, and when we all do our part, it adds up in big ways.

#

Hi friend, this is Ken Burns.
**_299
**_
That's the number of times Mark Kelly landed his A-6 Intruder on the USS Midway.
A Navy pilot contends with the ocean, the wind, and the aircraft carrier — not to mention their own plane. It's one of the most challenging things a person can do, and he did it 299 times.

That’s the good news.

[**I hate asking, Peter, but we don’t have much of a choice. With McCarthy’s super PAC doubling down on attack ads, I’m hoping you can add a contribution of $3 to help us win this race.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51900062/370657580/-396165772?refcode=em-10.3.22-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS85MzkwNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjY2E3MThhZS02OTQzLWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9yv1314tbQhPTUr1rExmRQr6wMyWc9qDQ4atQ2eL-48=)

body:
Without borders and without the rule of law we have nothing.

| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61488831:JmlLCtVNx:m:1:3317145305:20443D2BFF0B1C050486F87AE85E1178:r)

Peter,

In April of this year, illegal alien Avellaneda Anselmo was arrested for selling cocaine in a small town in North Carolina.

Around the same time, three different illegal aliens by the names of Juan Jose Miranda Valencia, Lorenzo Miranda, and Victor Reyes-Mariano were busted with drugs they allegedly intended to sell.

In a 24-hour period, half a dozen illegal immigrants were arrested for drunk driving in one of North Carolina's "sanctuary counties."

_And I wish that was the worst of it._

In Virginia, three illegal immigrants (Yang Gao, Ye Wang and Si Liu) were arrested for running a human trafficking ring.

Last month, police arrested Andre Rolando Ramos on multiple child porn charges.

Just a few short weeks ago, U.S. Border Patrol apprehended Isaias Pulido-Alvarado - a drug dealer AND child rapist - who only served a measly year for his crimes in Wisconsin before being released.

**And the Biden administration wants these people to stay here.**

We're fighting back against the administration's horrific policies which basically allow felons to remain in the United States indefinitely, but we need your help.

[**Which is why I'm asking you to send an urgent gift of $35 or more right now to the Immigration Reform Law Institute.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61488831:JmlLCtVNx:m:1:3317145305:20443D2BFF0B1C050486F87AE85E1178:r)

That's right.

Under Joe Biden's new policies, it's next to impossible to deport KNOWN criminals like this - no matter how heinous their crimes.

**If you want to do everything in your power to stop them, I need you to read this letter from beginning to end.**

The states of Texas and Louisiana are suing the Biden administration over their plummeting standards for deporting criminal aliens - and the Immigration Reform Law Institute (IRLI) has filed briefs in the case alongside them to assist the court. I have provided hours of expert testimony at the trial.

These briefs are an important part of the legal process that inform the judge about our case and can make the difference between a win or a loss in court.

We need your help to keep fighting.

[**That's why I hope I can count on your generous, tax-deductible donation to IRLI right away**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61488831:JmlLCtVNx:m:1:3317145305:20443D2BFF0B1C050486F87AE85E1178:r)**, to give us the ammunition we need to uphold the rule of law not just in Texas and Louisiana, but across our country.**

My name is Tom Homan, and I'm the former acting director of Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) under President Trump and now a Senior Fellow at IRLI.

I know firsthand what's going on at our border - and just how hard this administration is making it for Border Patrol and ICE to do their jobs.

**That's why I joined IRLI - an incredible legal team created to fight for the American people, uphold our rule of law, and stop bad immigration policies.**

They have proven themselves time after time.

Every time they've taken on the Biden administration, they've won - and that's thanks to patriots like you.

You see, while IRLI's attorneys get results, they still face a constant uphill battle against anti-borders groups funded by billionaires like George Soros.

_They know that without borders and without the rule of law we have nothing._

[**If you understand just how important IRLI's work is, I hope I can count on your generous, tax-deductible donation right away.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61488831:JmlLCtVNx:m:1:3317145305:20443D2BFF0B1C050486F87AE85E1178:r)

The United States of America must deport criminal aliens.

That's the law, and we're fighting tooth and nail to uphold it.

The truth is, I wouldn't be surprised if this goes all the way up to the Supreme Court

The Biden administration wants them right here, on your side of the border, in your communities, doing what they want when they want.

IRLI won't stand for this - and I hope you won't either.

Sincerely,
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61488831:JmlLCtVNx:m:1:3317145305:20443D2BFF0B1C050486F87AE85E1178:r)
Tom Homan
IRLI Senior Fellow and former ICE Acting Director

P.S. Your gift will give our attorneys the resources they need in this crucial legal battle and force the Biden administration to start deporting the illegal alien criminals they've released all over our country. [**I hope I can count on your generous, tax-deductible donation to IRLI today.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61488831:JmlLCtVNx:m:1:3317145305:20443D2BFF0B1C050486F87AE85E1178:r)

Under Joe Biden's new policies, it's next to impossible to deport KNOWN criminals like this - no matter how heinous their crimes. If you want to do everything in your power to stop them, I need you to read this letter from beginning to end. The states of Texas and Louisiana are suing the Biden administration over their plummeting standards for deporting criminal aliens - and the Immigration Reform Law Institute (IRLI) has filed briefs in the case alongside them to assist the court. I have provided hours of expert testimony at the trial. These briefs are an important part of the legal process that inform the judge about our case and can make the difference between a win or a loss in court. We need your help to keep fighting. , to give us the ammunition we need to uphold the rule of law not just in Texas and Louisiana, but across our country. My name is Tom Homan, and I'm the former acting director of Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) under President Trump and now a Senior Fellow at IRLI. I know firsthand what's going on at our border - and just how hard this administration is making it for Border Patrol and ICE to do their jobs. That's why I joined IRLI - an incredible legal team created to fight for the American people, uphold our rule of law, and stop bad immigration policies. They have proven themselves time after time. Every time they've taken on the Biden administration, they've won - and that's thanks to patriots like you. You see, while IRLI's attorneys get results, they still face a constant uphill battle against anti-borders groups funded by billionaires like George Soros. They know that without borders and without the rule of law we have nothing. The United States of America must deport criminal aliens. That's the law, and we're fighting tooth and nail to uphold it. The truth is, I wouldn't be surprised if this goes all the way up to the Supreme Court The Biden administration wants them right here, on your side of the border, in your communities, doing what they want when they want. IRLI won't stand for this - and I hope you won't either. Sincerely, Tom Homan IRLI Senior Fellow and former ICE Acting Director P.S. 916.475.4900

October 3, 2022
**JIM COSTA RESIGNS
from Showing up to Debate**
_Statement from Former Law Enforcement Officer and Navy Veteran Michael Maher_
_Last night I was informed that my opponent, Jim Costa, will not be showing up to debate me. I was scheduled to debate Jim Costa on Monday, October 3rd, at 6:30 p.m. at the American Legion Post 509 in Fresno. The debate was to be hosted by the Central Valley Veterans Political Action Alliance, which has a long-established history of hosting Congressional, U.S. Senate, and Gubernatorial candidate debates. Costa has participated numerous times in their debates, and his staff is well aware of this organization. This debate has been put off and pushed back far too many times, and my campaign was given no justifiable reason for Costa’s absence. Congress is currently out of session, and Costa’s schedule should allow him to appear before his constituents and my fellow veterans.

Jim Costa has a long track record of not showing up for the people; he will likely continue to not show up for debates, just like he has been absent for the people he represents on crucial, pressing issues: lowering the cost of gas, groceries, and utilities; addressing out-of-control inflation; tackling the ever-growing homelessness crisis; dealing with increasing crime, and the tidal wave of fentanyl hitting our streets, which is taking so many lives.

Whether or not Jim Costa chooses to debate me, this is another excellent example of his lack of concern for the people he represents. We, the people, remain a means to an end for him to hold on to power for his pleasure.

P.S. **The event location will remain open** , and we are encouraged to show up.**I will be there to answer questions tonight** so the **public and our veterans** may learn more about me and my vision for delivering a better future. I am looking forward to seeing everyone, **Republican, Democrat, Independent, NPP, and whoever wants to come together to help build a brighter future.**_

If anti-democracy candidates like Doug Mastriano (PA), Kari Lake (AZ), and others had been in power in 2020, it’s very possible that **Donald Trump would have succeeded** in overturning the election and remaining in power. But it’s not just anti-democracy governors who pose a threat in 2024 — gerrymandered legislatures could try to overturn legitimate election results, too:
**"How Six States Could Overturn the 2024 Election"**

"Six swing states—Pennsylvania, Michigan, Wisconsin, Arizona, Georgia, and North Carolina—are trending blue in presidential elections but ruled by gerrymandered Republican state legislatures."

_— The Atlantic_

At the NDRC, everything we’re doing right now is aimed at preventing that from happening. From fighting back against GOP voter suppression to supporting over 400 Democracy Defenders in 17 swing states across the country, we have a **comprehensive plan to protect our democracy** — but we need your help to keep up our work.
There are a few reasons to be optimistic:
* Women are registering to vote in **historic numbers** after SCOTUS overturned _Roe v. Wade._

* Our plan to defend democracy is modeled after our plan to fight GOP gerrymandering, which helped produce some of the **fairest House maps** this country has seen in decades in 2021.

But there’s also reason to worry: **The midterm elections are just weeks away** , and many of the candidates who win this November will be responsible for administering or certifying the election in 2024. It’s _crucial_ that we do everything we can to help elect pro-democracy candidates _this year_ if we want to ensure a smooth and fair presidential election two years from now.

clean_body: It’s critical that we stop anti-democracy candidates like Doug Mastriano and Kari Lake this November. | | = Team, If anti-democracy candidates like Doug Mastriano (PA), Kari Lake (AZ), and others had been in power in 2020, it’s very possible that Donald Trump would have succeeded in overturning the election and remaining in power. But it’s not just anti-democracy governors who pose a threat in 2024 — gerrymandered legislatures could try to overturn legitimate election results, too: "How Six States Could Overturn the 2024 Election" "Six swing states—Pennsylvania, Michigan, Wisconsin, Arizona, Georgia, and North Carolina—are trending blue in presidential elections but ruled by gerrymandered Republican state legislatures." — The Atlantic | = At the NDRC, everything we’re doing right now is aimed at preventing that from happening. From fighting back against GOP voter suppression to supporting over 400 Democracy Defenders in 17 swing states across the country, we have a comprehensive plan to protect our democracy — but we need your help to keep up our work. There are a few reasons to be optimistic: Women are registering to vote in historic numbers after SCOTUS overturned Roe v. Wade. Our plan to defend democracy is modeled after our plan to fight GOP gerrymandering, which helped produce some of the fairest House maps this country has seen in decades in 2021. But there’s also reason to worry: The midterm elections are just weeks away , and many of the candidates who win this November will be responsible for administering or certifying the election in 2024. It’s crucial that we do everything we can to help elect pro-democracy candidates this year if we want to ensure a smooth and fair presidential election two years from now. And team, we need your help to do it. The Town Hall will be held on **Friday, Oct. 7, 2022, from 5:30 p.m. to 7 p.m.** at the **Lewis and Clark Library in the Large Community Room** (120 S. Last Chance Gulch St., Helena, MT 59601).

#

You already know me + my team stand firmly on #TeamPuppy. Our pups, Levi + Artie, are basically spokesdogs for my campaign.

**[Derek, we can’t afford to send a literal puppy killer to the U.S. Senate. **Dr. Oz has killed HUNDREDS of dogs throughout his career, including an entire litter of puppies.** Every day this guy proves he’s just the worst of the worst.

I know Gisele, the kids + I will give Levi + Artie a little extra love (and cheese) tonight after hearing this news... and I hope you do the same for your pups too.
Thanks for hearing me out,
John
